epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Jas正與妹妹Laura享受著鄉郊的平靜假期,這份寧靜卻被一群突然出現的流浪漢徹底打破。Laura慘遭殺害後,Jas回到租來的小屋,發現妹妹冰冷的屍體。在悲慟與狂怒之中,她誓言追獵這群兇徒到底,定要其..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jass peaceful countryside getaway with her sister Laura is shattered when a group of drifters attacks them. After Laura is brutally killed, Jas discovers her lifeless body at their rented cabin. Consumed by grief and fury, she vows to hunt down the gang and take vengeance on her sisters murderer.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事改編自真實事件,一位專門研究外星人和外星生物的年輕科學家,決心要揭開喀拉拉邦連串怪異事件背後的謎團。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Based on true events, a young scientist who specialises in the study of aliens and extraterrestrials sets out to uncover the mystery behind a series of strange occurrences in Kerala.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 資深主播艾米遭遇詭異蝙蝠襲擊後,帶著傷口返回電台,準備主持當晚的深夜節目。豈料竟遭無良老闆設局解僱,並被新人強行取代。適逢暴風雨封鎖整座電台,隨著傷口引發的異變愈演愈烈,艾米逐漸失控,在直播間掀起一場..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Radio host Amy is bitten by a mysterious bat, but she returns to the station to host that night’s late-night show. Instead, she is set up and fired by her ruthless boss, then replaced by a newcomer. As a violent storm traps everyone in the station and her mysterious wound worsens, Amy gradually loses control and unleashes a bloody massacre.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 狄仁傑﻿捲入一宗震撼大唐的連環命案,兇手以「七宗罪」為名,自詡正義,試圖為其扭曲的道德觀辯護。在他不懈追尋真相的過程中,狄仁傑揭開了偽正義的面具,暴露了潛藏背後的黑暗真相。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Detective Dee becomes embroiled in a series of murders that shake the Tang Empire. The killer invokes the Seven Deadly Sins to justify a twisted sense of justice. In his relentless pursuit of the truth, Detective Dee uncovers the mask of false righteousness and exposes the darkness hidden beneath.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 建築師May與男友Gun搬入新居後,驟聞繼母離奇身亡。May收留孤苦的繼妹Noon,怎料她入宅後竟行為詭異,頻遭惡靈附身,而May也陷入恐怖幻象與嚴重失眠的折磨。隨著宅內黑暗秘密逐步揭開,通靈法師終於..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After moving into a house with her boyfriend, Gun, architect May learns of her stepmother’s mysterious death. When May takes in her stepsister Noon, the girl begins showing signs of possession, while May suffers disturbing visions and insomnia. As dark secrets emerge, spiritual masters uncover an ancient black-magic curse hidden within the house.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個單親媽媽郁香和她的女兒童童搬進了一個住宅區展開新生活。區內住著一個個看似幸福美滿的家庭,背後卻藏著許多不為人知的秘密,而人性的黑暗面亦一步步被揭開. . .
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A single-parent family (Yu Xiang and Tong Tong) moves into a new neighbourhood where everyone’s life seems perfect.  However, while things may look rosy on the outside, dark secrets and horror raid each family from the inside, and nothing really are as they seem.

epg.programme_title_tc: Anak Perjanjian Syaitan 2 (aka Offspring of the Devils Pact 2)
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孤兒Azlinda從小就受到鬼魂的困擾,相信這些折磨與父母的暗黑歷史密切相關。她的朋友Zurina、Wati和Ustaz攜手合作,希望結束她的痛苦,但卻被一個邪惡的惡魔阻撓。Azlinda能否成功斬斷..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Haunted since childhood, orphan Azlinda believes her torment stems from her parents dark history. Her friends Zurina, Wati, and Ustaz join forces to end her suffering, but a malevolent demon interrupts their efforts. Will Azlinda succeed in severing the cursed ties that bind her, or is she destined to remain trapped in darkness forever?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 幼女離奇失蹤後,悲痛的Drew與Helen在治療師安排下,前往偏遠林中小屋接受深度諮商。隨著孤立與壓抑逐漸侵蝕理智,療癒之旅化為噩夢。Helen飽受詭異幻象與異象困擾,逐漸分不清現實與幻覺,心智瀕臨崩..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After their young daughter’s mysterious disappearance, Drew and Helen retreat to a secluded woodland cottage for therapy. As they struggle to salvage their marriage, isolation fractures their sanity. Haunted by visions and strange events, Helen can no longer tell what is real as her mind unravels.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 書生王懷卿賣畫,為要籌藥費救患重病的妻子,途中意外遇上雀妖的追擊,幸得狐妖小容相救。為躲避雀妖,王懷卿將小容帶回家中,三人隨即陷入一場情感困局,而一段淒美的人妖虐戀亦隨即展開。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Scholar Wang Huai Qing sells paintings to save his ailing wife. He is attacked by a bird demon along the way but is rescued by Fox demon Xiao Rong. To elude the pursuit, Wang brings Xiao Rong home, sparking a love triangle and at the same time, unfolding an impending love between human and demon.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在一個沿海小鎮,Rico與Sisca發展了一段不可能的戀情,卻因他們相愛而引發惡靈的出現。隨著整個城鎮發生連串駭人聽聞的死亡事件,也揭露了隱藏多年的秘密,使到整個城鎮被一股恐怖力量所控制。Rico必需..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a coastal town, a forbidden romance sparks between Rico and Sisca, and their love unleashes a malevolent spirit. As chilling deaths plague the town, past secrets are being unraveled and the town is possessed by evil and fear. Rico must defy destiny and fight against the evil spirit to save his loved one.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 消失三年的鬼手及其盜墓團夥重現江城,再次下墓摸金。怎料四名盜墓賊在開棺時遇驚魂邪煞,逃離後又接連慘死家中。最終古墓屍毒和針孔成為留給員警沈春合僅有的線索,看似普通的盜墓案,瞬間撲朔迷離疑點重重。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ghost Hand and his tomb raiders resurface in Jiang City to seek gold in ancient tombs after a 3-year absence. They released an evil spirit from a coffin and all four died at home eventually. Poison and pinholes in the corpses become the sole clue for police investigation. A tomb raid now unfolds as a perplexing and mysterious case.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一位記者調查二十年前紙人回魂案時,聽到三個關於恐怖紙人的故事。故事起源於喬府大小姐喬媛媛枉死後,管家請紙紮匠為小姐做了紙人陪葬。紙人被點眼睛後,大小姐得以借紙人回魂復仇,更接二連三引發連串與紙人有關的..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A reporter hears three horror stories when investigating a case of the paper doll spirit 20 years ago. Miss Qiao had died in vain then, and her butler paid a paper craftsman to make a paper doll to be buried with her. Miss Qiao’s spirit is revived to take revenge when the doll’s eyes are drawn, and a series of horrible events begins to happen...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 瑪莉因丈夫工作上的調遷,搬回位於郊區的家鄉。當瑪莉在新房子等候丈夫的時候,一個冰淇淋車殺手已把她視為下一個要殺掉的目標人物。此刻,瑪莉發覺家鄉已不如昔日般平靜安寧…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mary moves back to her suburban hometown as her husband is relocated there for work. While waiting for her husband in their new house, Mary becomes the target of an evil slasher that stalks the suburbs in an ice-cream truck. She soon learns that the suburbs are not what they seem...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在一個沿海小鎮,Rico與Sisca發展了一段不可能的戀情,卻因他們相愛而引發惡靈的出現。隨著整個城鎮發生連串駭人聽聞的死亡事件,也揭露了隱藏多年的秘密,使到整個城鎮被一股恐怖力量所控制。Rico必需..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a coastal town, a forbidden romance sparks between Rico and Sisca, and their love unleashes a malevolent spirit. As chilling deaths plague the town, past secrets are being unraveled and the town is possessed by evil and fear. Rico must defy destiny and fight against the evil spirit to save his loved one.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 消失三年的鬼手及其盜墓團夥重現江城,再次下墓摸金。怎料四名盜墓賊在開棺時遇驚魂邪煞,逃離後又接連慘死家中。最終古墓屍毒和針孔成為留給員警沈春合僅有的線索,看似普通的盜墓案,瞬間撲朔迷離疑點重重。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ghost Hand and his tomb raiders resurface in Jiang City to seek gold in ancient tombs after a 3-year absence. They released an evil spirit from a coffin and all four died at home eventually. Poison and pinholes in the corpses become the sole clue for police investigation. A tomb raid now unfolds as a perplexing and mysterious case.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一位記者調查二十年前紙人回魂案時,聽到三個關於恐怖紙人的故事。故事起源於喬府大小姐喬媛媛枉死後,管家請紙紮匠為小姐做了紙人陪葬。紙人被點眼睛後,大小姐得以借紙人回魂復仇,更接二連三引發連串與紙人有關的..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A reporter hears three horror stories when investigating a case of the paper doll spirit 20 years ago. Miss Qiao had died in vain then, and her butler paid a paper craftsman to make a paper doll to be buried with her. Miss Qiao’s spirit is revived to take revenge when the doll’s eyes are drawn, and a series of horrible events begins to happen...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 瑪莉因丈夫工作上的調遷,搬回位於郊區的家鄉。當瑪莉在新房子等候丈夫的時候,一個冰淇淋車殺手已把她視為下一個要殺掉的目標人物。此刻,瑪莉發覺家鄉已不如昔日般平靜安寧…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mary moves back to her suburban hometown as her husband is relocated there for work. While waiting for her husband in their new house, Mary becomes the target of an evil slasher that stalks the suburbs in an ice-cream truck. She soon learns that the suburbs are not what they seem...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 豔麗女模余虹敏在一間盛傳鬧鬼的廢棄醫院中離奇身亡。事後,她生前的攝影師不斷接到如怨靈索命般的詭異來電,合作撰稿人突遭嚴重車禍,而她的摯友亦突然離奇失蹤。一連串毛骨悚然的怪事接踵而來,彷彿死者充滿妒恨的..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Model Min dies mysteriously in a hospital rumoured to be haunted. Soon after, her photographer receives eerie phone calls, a writer suffers a bizarre car accident, and Min’s friend suddenly vanishes. As fear spreads, dark secrets and supernatural forces emerge, drawing them into a terrifying nightmare linked to Min’s death.

epg.programme_title_en: Detective Dee: The Ghosts in Weird Town
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 狄仁傑調查幽冥鎮接連發生的離奇僵屍變異事件,意外揭露幕後黑手竟是圖謀叛亂的越王李貞。面對亡靈肆虐與重重陰謀,狄仁傑憑藉機智與膽識力挫邪惡勢力,揭露了李貞的叛亂計畫。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Detective Dee investigates a series of terrifying vampire transformations in Youming Town, uncovering a sinister conspiracy masterminded by Prince Li Zhen, who plots to overthrow the empire. Armed with courage and ingenuity, Dee defeats the bloodthirsty vampires and ultimately exposes the prince’s dark ambitions.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 雙胞胎兄妹在偏遠旅館渡過恐怖的一夜,為調查其父親在兩人出生前失蹤的真相。當他們深入調查後,旅館的暗黑秘密把他們困於地獄迷宮中,兄妹二人定要在黎明前逃離險境。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A pair of fraternal twins spend a terrifying night in a remote inn to investigate the last known whereabouts of their father who mysteriously disappeared the night they were born. As they dive deeper, the propertys dark secrets ensnare them in a hellish labyrinth which they must escape before dawn.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟朋友在酒吧喝酒的女孩邂逅恐怖小說家,兩人一見鍾情感情迅速升溫。原來女孩已悄然落入驚天迷局,全因小說家的前女友是個毀容的女鬼,她借用人面還魂復仇,與前男友聯手開啟奪命驚嚇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young girl encounters a novelist in a bar and quickly falls in love with him. However, it turns out she has fallen into a trap set up by the novelist and his ex-girlfriend who is a ghost with a disfigured face. The journey of revenge and ultimate terror has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個寧靜的晚上,一名患精神病的連環殺手擾亂了年輕夫婦的平淡生活。當這對夫婦為生存而戰時,他們隱藏多年的秘密亦隨之揭開,期間更意外地被牽連到黑社會的地下世界中。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young couples tranquility is shattered by a psychotic serial killer one quiet evening. Their battle for survival reveals hidden truths, entangling them unwittingly with the criminal underworld.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 靜雯是一名努力奮鬥的戲劇學生,為了應付學費開支而接受了一份模特兒的工作。然而,當她為一位專門從事表現性人體素描的神秘藝術家擔任模特兒時,靜雯意外地揭露了一個驚人真相,更將她推向生死邊緣。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jing Wen, a struggling drama student, takes on a modelling job to help cover her tuition costs. As she becomes a model for an enigmatic artist specializing in expressive human body sketches, Jing Wen accidentally uncovers a shocking truth, plunging her into a desperate fight for survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 豔麗女模余虹敏在一間盛傳鬧鬼的廢棄醫院中離奇身亡。事後,她生前的攝影師不斷接到如怨靈索命般的詭異來電,合作撰稿人突遭嚴重車禍,而她的摯友亦突然離奇失蹤。一連串毛骨悚然的怪事接踵而來,彷彿死者充滿妒恨的..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Model Min dies mysteriously in a hospital rumoured to be haunted. Soon after, her photographer receives eerie phone calls, a writer suffers a bizarre car accident, and Min’s friend suddenly vanishes. As fear spreads, dark secrets and supernatural forces emerge, drawing them into a terrifying nightmare linked to Min’s death.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 席維斯・史特龍主演《???》,飾演一名失意英雄,在紐約市隧道崩塌之際,與時間賽跑營救受困通勤族。爆炸性的動作與懸疑氣氛,成就這部高風險災難驚悚片。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Sylvester Stallone stars in Daylight as a fallen hero racing to rescue commuters trapped in a collapsing NYC tunnel. Explosive action and suspense power this high-stakes disaster thriller!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一位才華洋溢卻備受爭議的科學家,執著於打造具有人性智慧的機器,最終引發危險而不可預測的後果。這是一場科技與倫理的極限挑戰,也是一段關於人性與未來的深刻探討。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A brilliant but controversial research scientist becomes obsessed with his quest to create a humanistic machine, leading to a dangerous conclusion.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿諾史瓦辛格在《魔鬼孩子王》中飾演強悍的偵探約翰金布爾,他臥底成為一名教師,以尋找毒梟的妻子。這部經典的喜劇驚悚片充滿了動作、幽默和感人。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Arnold Schwarzenegger stars as tough detective John Kimble in Kindergarten Cop, going undercover as a teacher to find a drug lords wife. Packed with action, humor, and heart, it’s a classic comedy-thriller.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在《超世紀戰警》中,馮·迪索回歸飾演雷迪克,此時的他是一名被流放到殘酷監獄的逃犯。在凱拉的陪伴下,他必須逃離這裡並擊敗死亡兵團,以拯救銀河系。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In *The Chronicles of Riddick*, Vin Diesel returns as Riddick, now a fugitive exiled to a brutal prison. With Kyra by his side, he must escape and defeat the Necromongers to save the galaxy.

epg.programme_title_tc: 奪寶大戰:受詛咒的聖盃
epg.programme_title_en: The Librarian: The Curse Of The Judas Chalice
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 因為在拍賣會上取得魔法的「賢者之石」而忽略女友,弗林・卡森因此被命令去度假。來到紐奧良後,他卻忙於保護「猶大聖杯」,並試圖阻止吸血鬼威脅世界。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Losing his girlfriend because he was at an auction getting the magical Philosophers Stone, Flynn Carsen is ordered to take a vacation. In New Orleans he finds himself busy protecting the Judas Chalice and saving the world from vampires.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 麥可·法斯賓達主演這部改編自知名電玩遊戲系列的動作冒險電影,講述一名男子發現自己是一個古老刺客組織後裔的故事。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Michael Fassbender stars in this action-adventure film based on the acclaimed video game franchise about a man who discovers hes a descendant of an ancient line of Assassins.

epg.programme_title_en: The Curse Of King Tuts Tomb Part 1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 1922年的開羅,考古學家丹尼・弗里蒙特與邪惡宿敵展開競賽,爭奪能掌控——甚至毀滅——世界的圖坦卡門翡翠石板。他必須深入帝王谷,解開足以改變歷史的終極謎團。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In 1922 Cairo, archaeologist Danny Fremont races his evil nemesis to find King Tuts Emerald Tablet, the ultimate power to control—or destroy—the world. He must brave the Valley of the Kings to solve a mystery that could change history forever.

epg.programme_title_en: The Curse Of King Tuts Tomb Part 2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 1922年的開羅,考古學家丹尼・弗里蒙特與邪惡宿敵展開競賽,爭奪能掌控——甚至毀滅——世界的圖坦卡門翡翠石板。他必須深入帝王谷,解開足以改變歷史的終極謎團。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In 1922 Cairo, archaeologist Danny Fremont races his evil nemesis to find King Tuts Emerald Tablet, the ultimate power to control—or destroy—the world. He must brave the Valley of the Kings to solve a mystery that could change history forever.

epg.programme_title_tc: 奪寶大戰: 重返水晶骷髏王國
epg.programme_title_en: The Librarian: The Return To King Solomons Mines
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 冒險家弗林.卡森收到一幅指向所羅門王礦脈的神秘地圖。當地圖被盜後,弗林踏上旅程尋回地圖及《所羅門之鑰》,一旦缺少這本書,地圖也將變得毫無用處。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adventurer Flynn Carsen receives a secret map to King Solomons Mines. When the map is stolen, Flynn sets out to find the map and the Key of Solomons book, without which the map is useless anyway.

epg.programme_title_tc: 奪寶大戰:尋找命運之矛的探險
epg.programme_title_en: The Librarian: The Quest For The Spear
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名書蟲成了新的圖書館員。就在同一晚,一支具有魔力的長槍被盜,他因此踏上環遊世界的實戰冒險旅程,尋回長槍——旅程的第一步,就是被他那可愛的助手從飛機上扔到亞馬遜雨林上空。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A bookworm becomes the librarian. Same night a magical spear gets stolen and hes off to get some real life experience around the globe on his quest for the spear - starting with being thrown off a plane over Amazonas by his cute helper.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在《決戰末世代》中,一種致命病毒於隔離數十年後再度現身。混亂爆發之際,一支小隊進入被封鎖的禁區尋找解藥。動作凌厲、風格粗獷,這是一場為生存而戰的殊死任務。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Doomsday, a deadly virus resurfaces decades after quarantine. As chaos erupts, a team enters the walled-off zone to find a cure. Action-packed and gritty, its a battle for survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 第一次世界大戰期間,一名英國偷獵者、一名美國冒險家,以及他迷人的年輕女兒,聯手策劃摧毀一艘正在桑給巴爾外海灣進行維修的德國戰鬥巡洋艦。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: During World War One, an English poacher, an American adventurer, and his attractive young daughter set out to destroy a German battle-cruiser awaiting repairs in an inlet just off Zanzibar.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 武林高手加入紅蓮花會,圖謀推翻暴君。總督追捕會眾,一名武者在爭奪商人之女的比武招親中墜入愛河,性別角色顛倒的武俠喜劇就此展開。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Martial artists join Red Lotus Flower Society to overthrow evil emperor. Governor hunts society members. Kung fu practitioner falls for merchants daughter amid kung fu contest for her hand. Gender role reversal comedy ensues.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名年輕人移居泰國並在一家冰廠工作,原本立誓絕不使用暴力,但在堂兄弟相繼失蹤、且發現該工廠竟是毒品走私的掩護後,他打破誓言以挺身對抗貪腐的大老闆。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Moving to Thailand to work at an ice factory under a strict anti-violence vow, a young boy breaks his oath to confront a corrupt boss after his cousins disappear and he discovers the business is a front for drug smuggling.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名年輕人移居泰國並在一家冰廠工作,原本立誓絕不使用暴力,但在堂兄弟相繼失蹤、且發現該工廠竟是毒品走私的掩護後,他打破誓言以挺身對抗貪腐的大老闆。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Moving to Thailand to work at an ice factory under a strict anti-violence vow, a young boy breaks his oath to confront a corrupt boss after his cousins disappear and he discovers the business is a front for drug smuggling.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一場巨大地震引發連鎖反應,威脅著全球兩座最大型核反應爐。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A massive earthquake creates a chain of events that threaten two of the largest nuclear reactors.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一場巨大地震引發連鎖反應,威脅著全球兩座最大型核反應爐。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A massive earthquake creates a chain of events that threaten two of the largest nuclear reactors.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 李奧納多·狄卡皮歐與湯姆·哈迪主演阿利安卓·崗札雷·伊納利圖執導的這部史詩級震撼巨作。故事根據真實事件改編,背景設定在美國未開墾的荒野,講述一段關於生存與背叛的故事。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Leonardo DiCaprio and Tom Hardy star in Alejandro González Iñárritus visceral, epic tale of survival and betrayal inspired by true events thats set in Americas uncharted wilderness.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 麥特戴蒙回歸,再次飾演傑森伯恩,保羅葛林格拉斯執導的《神鬼認證:傑森包恩》也將繼續上演驚險刺激的續集。伯恩被迫重出江湖,與艾莉西亞·維坎德、文森特·卡塞爾等眾多明星聯袂出擊,共同面對新的危機。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Matt Damon returns as Jason Bourne in Jason Bourne, with director Paul Greengrass back for another thrilling chapter. Bourne is drawn out of hiding, facing new dangers with Alicia Vikander, Vincent Cassel, and more.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事以動盪不安的當代芝加哥為背景,四個毫無共同點的女人,唯一的交集是她們已故丈夫因犯罪活動而留下的債務。她們決定掌握自己的命運,共同謀劃依據自己的方式開創未來。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set in contemporary Chicago, amidst a time of turmoil, four women with nothing in common except a debt left behind by their dead husbands criminal activities, take fate into their own hands, and conspire to forge a future on their own terms.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 席維斯・史特龍主演《???》,飾演一名失意英雄,在紐約市隧道崩塌之際,與時間賽跑營救受困通勤族。爆炸性的動作與懸疑氣氛,成就這部高風險災難驚悚片。

epg.programme_title_tc: 奪寶大戰:尋找命運之矛的探險
epg.programme_title_en: The Librarian: The Quest For The Spear
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名書蟲成了新的圖書館員。就在同一晚,一支具有魔力的長槍被盜,他因此踏上環遊世界的實戰冒險旅程,尋回長槍——旅程的第一步,就是被他那可愛的助手從飛機上扔到亞馬遜雨林上空。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A bookworm becomes the librarian. Same night a magical spear gets stolen and hes off to get some real life experience around the globe on his quest for the spear - starting with being thrown off a plane over Amazonas by his cute helper.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在戰後的日本,哥吉拉的出現為滿目瘡痍的國土帶來了新的浩劫。當軍方無力介入、政府束手無策之際,倖存者們必須在絕望中團結起來,迎戰這股無情的恐怖力量。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In postwar Japan, Godzilla brings new devastation to an already scorched landscape. With no military intervention or government help in sight, the survivors must join together in the face of despair and fight back against an unrelenting horror.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 第一次世界大戰期間,一名英國偷獵者、一名美國冒險家,以及他迷人的年輕女兒,聯手策劃摧毀一艘正在桑給巴爾外海灣進行維修的德國戰鬥巡洋艦。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: During World War One, an English poacher, an American adventurer, and his attractive young daughter set out to destroy a German battle-cruiser awaiting repairs in an inlet just off Zanzibar.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 武林高手加入紅蓮花會,圖謀推翻暴君。總督追捕會眾,一名武者在爭奪商人之女的比武招親中墜入愛河,性別角色顛倒的武俠喜劇就此展開。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Martial artists join Red Lotus Flower Society to overthrow evil emperor. Governor hunts society members. Kung fu practitioner falls for merchants daughter amid kung fu contest for her hand. Gender role reversal comedy ensues.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名年輕人移居泰國並在一家冰廠工作,原本立誓絕不使用暴力,但在堂兄弟相繼失蹤、且發現該工廠竟是毒品走私的掩護後,他打破誓言以挺身對抗貪腐的大老闆。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Moving to Thailand to work at an ice factory under a strict anti-violence vow, a young boy breaks his oath to confront a corrupt boss after his cousins disappear and he discovers the business is a front for drug smuggling.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一場巨大地震引發連鎖反應,威脅著全球兩座最大型核反應爐。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A massive earthquake creates a chain of events that threaten two of the largest nuclear reactors.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一場巨大地震引發連鎖反應,威脅著全球兩座最大型核反應爐。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A massive earthquake creates a chain of events that threaten two of the largest nuclear reactors.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 陳真回到20世紀初的上海準備與未婚妻結婚,卻發現自己敬重的武術師父神秘身亡。他隨即展開嚴酷的復仇行動,誓要對抗對此負責的日本對手武館。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Returning to early 20th-century Shanghai to marry his fiancée, Chen Zhen discovers his revered martial arts master has died mysteriously. He launches a relentless quest for vengeance against the rival Japanese dojo responsible.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 約翰·蘭博被政府從監獄釋放,執行一項絕密任務,前往他最不想回去的地方——越南叢林。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: John Rambo is released from prison by the government for a top-secret covert mission to the last place on Earth he’d want to return - the jungles of Vietnam.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 李奧納多·狄卡皮歐與湯姆·哈迪主演阿利安卓·崗札雷·伊納利圖執導的這部史詩級震撼巨作。故事根據真實事件改編,背景設定在美國未開墾的荒野,講述一段關於生存與背叛的故事。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Leonardo DiCaprio and Tom Hardy star in Alejandro González Iñárritus visceral, epic tale of survival and betrayal inspired by true events thats set in Americas uncharted wilderness.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adventurer Flynn Carsen receives a secret map to King Solomons Mines. When the map is stolen, Flynn sets out to find the map and the Key of Solomons book, without which the map is useless anyway.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Sylvester Stallone stars in Daylight as a fallen hero racing to rescue commuters trapped in a collapsing NYC tunnel. Explosive action and suspense power this high-stakes disaster thriller!

epg.episode_synopsis_en: A unique cross-cultural Spaghetti Western where an outlaw and a stoic samurai are forced to team up in the American Southwest to track down a smooth bandit leader who stole a priceless ceremonial sword intended for the US President.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 憤世嫉俗的員工奧森厭惡他那些懶惰的同事。他發現了一間秘密的、神奇的辦公室,這間辦公室能顯著提升他的工作效率和地位,但他的同事們卻看不到這間辦公室,並因此對他的成功心生嫉妒。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Misanthropic worker Orson detests his lazy colleagues. He finds a secret, magical office that boosts his productivity and status, but his coworkers can’t see the room and grow to resent his success.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this suspenseful thriller, a high-priced and ruthless jury consultant will stop at nothing to secure a verdict on an explosive trial.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Doomsday, a deadly virus resurfaces decades after quarantine. As chaos erupts, a team enters the walled-off zone to find a cure. Action-packed and gritty, its a battle for survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 因為在拍賣會上取得魔法的「賢者之石」而忽略女友,弗林・卡森因此被命令去度假。來到紐奧良後,他卻忙於保護「猶大聖杯」,並試圖阻止吸血鬼威脅世界。

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Academy Award®-Nominee Sylvester Stallone stars in this explosive action-thriller that will keep you on the edge of your seat until the final, powerful frame!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 憤世嫉俗的員工奧森厭惡他那些懶惰的同事。他發現了一間秘密的、神奇的辦公室,這間辦公室能顯著提升他的工作效率和地位,但他的同事們卻看不到這間辦公室,並因此對他的成功心生嫉妒。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Misanthropic worker Orson detests his lazy colleagues. He finds a secret, magical office that boosts his productivity and status, but his coworkers can’t see the room and grow to resent his success.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In 1922 Cairo, archaeologist Danny Fremont races his evil nemesis to find King Tuts Emerald Tablet, the ultimate power to control—or destroy—the world. He must brave the Valley of the Kings to solve a mystery that could change history forever.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: John Rambo is released from prison by the government for a top-secret covert mission to the last place on Earth he’d want to return - the jungles of Vietnam.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 李奧納多·狄卡皮歐與湯姆·哈迪主演阿利安卓·崗札雷·伊納利圖執導的這部史詩級震撼巨作。故事根據真實事件改編,背景設定在美國未開墾的荒野,講述一段關於生存與背叛的故事。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Leonardo DiCaprio and Tom Hardy star in Alejandro González Iñárritus visceral, epic tale of survival and betrayal inspired by true events thats set in Americas uncharted wilderness.

epg.programme_title_tc: 奪寶大戰: 重返水晶骷髏王國
epg.programme_title_en: The Librarian: The Return To King Solomons Mines
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 冒險家弗林.卡森收到一幅指向所羅門王礦脈的神秘地圖。當地圖被盜後,弗林踏上旅程尋回地圖及《所羅門之鑰》,一旦缺少這本書,地圖也將變得毫無用處。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adventurer Flynn Carsen receives a secret map to King Solomons Mines. When the map is stolen, Flynn sets out to find the map and the Key of Solomons book, without which the map is useless anyway.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Michael Fassbender stars in this action-adventure film based on the acclaimed video game franchise about a man who discovers hes a descendant of an ancient line of Assassins.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一部風格獨特、跨越文化的義大利式西部片。講述一名法外之徒與一名冷酷的武士被迫在美國西南部聯手,追捕一名偷走欲獻給美國總統之無價禮儀寶劍的狡猾強盜首領。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A unique cross-cultural Spaghetti Western where an outlaw and a stoic samurai are forced to team up in the American Southwest to track down a smooth bandit leader who stole a priceless ceremonial sword intended for the US President.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在《回到未來 III》中,馬蒂穿越回1885年,從亡命之徒手中救了博士。這部影片充滿了笑話、動作和感人肺腑的劇情,是這部備受喜愛的三部曲史詩般的西部大結局。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Back to the Future Part III, Marty travels to 1885 to save Doc from an outlaw. Packed with laughs, action, and heart, it’s the epic Wild West finale to the beloved trilogy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 武林高手加入紅蓮花會,圖謀推翻暴君。總督追捕會眾,一名武者在爭奪商人之女的比武招親中墜入愛河,性別角色顛倒的武俠喜劇就此展開。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Martial artists join Red Lotus Flower Society to overthrow evil emperor. Governor hunts society members. Kung fu practitioner falls for merchants daughter amid kung fu contest for her hand. Gender role reversal comedy ensues.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在《決戰末世代》中,一種致命病毒於隔離數十年後再度現身。混亂爆發之際,一支小隊進入被封鎖的禁區尋找解藥。動作凌厲、風格粗獷,這是一場為生存而戰的殊死任務。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Doomsday, a deadly virus resurfaces decades after quarantine. As chaos erupts, a team enters the walled-off zone to find a cure. Action-packed and gritty, its a battle for survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this suspenseful thriller, a high-priced and ruthless jury consultant will stop at nothing to secure a verdict on an explosive trial.

epg.programme_title_tc: 奪寶大戰:尋找命運之矛的探險
epg.programme_title_en: The Librarian: The Quest For The Spear
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名書蟲成了新的圖書館員。就在同一晚,一支具有魔力的長槍被盜,他因此踏上環遊世界的實戰冒險旅程,尋回長槍——旅程的第一步,就是被他那可愛的助手從飛機上扔到亞馬遜雨林上空。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A bookworm becomes the librarian. Same night a magical spear gets stolen and hes off to get some real life experience around the globe on his quest for the spear - starting with being thrown off a plane over Amazonas by his cute helper.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名年輕人移居泰國並在一家冰廠工作,原本立誓絕不使用暴力,但在堂兄弟相繼失蹤、且發現該工廠竟是毒品走私的掩護後,他打破誓言以挺身對抗貪腐的大老闆。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Moving to Thailand to work at an ice factory under a strict anti-violence vow, a young boy breaks his oath to confront a corrupt boss after his cousins disappear and he discovers the business is a front for drug smuggling.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在戰後的日本,哥吉拉的出現為滿目瘡痍的國土帶來了新的浩劫。當軍方無力介入、政府束手無策之際,倖存者們必須在絕望中團結起來,迎戰這股無情的恐怖力量。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In postwar Japan, Godzilla brings new devastation to an already scorched landscape. With no military intervention or government help in sight, the survivors must join together in the face of despair and fight back against an unrelenting horror.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 麥可·法斯賓達主演這部改編自知名電玩遊戲系列的動作冒險電影,講述一名男子發現自己是一個古老刺客組織後裔的故事。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Michael Fassbender stars in this action-adventure film based on the acclaimed video game franchise about a man who discovers hes a descendant of an ancient line of Assassins.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 席維斯・史特龍主演《???》,飾演一名失意英雄,在紐約市隧道崩塌之際,與時間賽跑營救受困通勤族。爆炸性的動作與懸疑氣氛,成就這部高風險災難驚悚片。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Sylvester Stallone stars in Daylight as a fallen hero racing to rescue commuters trapped in a collapsing NYC tunnel. Explosive action and suspense power this high-stakes disaster thriller!

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Misanthropic worker Orson detests his lazy colleagues. He finds a secret, magical office that boosts his productivity and status, but his coworkers can’t see the room and grow to resent his success.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一場歷史性的太空發射引發了太陽風暴,如果無法及時阻止,災難性後果恐將波及整個地球——而時間已所剩無幾。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A historic space launch triggers a solar-storm event that could have cataclysmic repercussions for the planet if it isnt stopped in time - and time is running out.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 陳真回到20世紀初的上海準備與未婚妻結婚,卻發現自己敬重的武術師父神秘身亡。他隨即展開嚴酷的復仇行動,誓要對抗對此負責的日本對手武館。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Returning to early 20th-century Shanghai to marry his fiancée, Chen Zhen discovers his revered martial arts master has died mysteriously. He launches a relentless quest for vengeance against the rival Japanese dojo responsible.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華僑少女阿媚返港接任傳統武館掌門,因推行西式現代化管理而與思想守舊的大師兄衝突不斷。兩代人的觀念碰撞引發連串市井風波,更招來當地黑幫的挑釁滋事。生死關頭,師兄妹放下成見聯手抗敵,以一身真功夫對抗惡勢力,最終平息江湖風波,捍衛武館聲譽與武林風骨。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大導演李翰祥改編自己大受歡迎的專欄,盡現電影圈光怪陸離的趣事及傳聞,由愛將劉永和戴良純扮演不同角色,保證令你捧腹大笑。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 劇情主線在於張無忌、週芷若與趙明的三角戀,以及倚天劍屠龍刀秘密的最後答案。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Only by bringing together the powerful Heaven Sword and the mighty Dragon Sabre can six martial arts sects struggling for supremacy be saved in this thrilling sequel to Chu Yuans original hit.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 宋朝康王被困於金營巨宅,四周被武林高手嚴密看守。兩名身懷絕技的義士必須克服重重困難,完成看似不可能的任務,設法救出康王。

epg.episode_synopsis_en: During the Three Kingdoms period, a Taoist priest Yu Ji cures many patients with his supernatural powers and is loved by the people. However, the arrogant general Sun Che thinks that Yu Ji bewitches people and orders for him to be beheaded. Subsequen

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Three buddies find a rare artifact known as the Double-Faced God but are poisoned by Lady Wu who steals the treasure from them. Before they die, they get their wives to promise to train their children to take back what is rightfully theirs. These kid

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this surprisingly light-hearted Venoms martial arts adventure, a lone wanderer is repeatedly mistaken for someone else and drawn into a number of violent battles.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this Opera epic, a loyal Imperial Court servant gives up his own newborn son to save the prince from an evil official.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一代宗師黃飛鴻在廣東教授功夫,卻被一名惡毒土匪陷害黃飛鴻的弟子,更以搶劫及謀殺等罪行誣陷他。因此,黃飛鴻誓要與土匪對抗力證自己的清白,並為弟子報仇。

epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young singer Hsiao Yun becomes an overnight sensation after standing in for another singer at the eleventh hour. Her success comes at a heavy price however, when her love with a pianist suffers. On top of this, Hsiao Yun must also deal with the unw

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 俠盜金毛獅武功高強,經常劫富濟貧。一夜他遭黑幫突襲,幸遇太湖七獅,把他送往神醫處救治。神醫攜金毛獅赴回魂谷採藥治傷,卻屢遭黑幫追殺,險象環生...

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Gui Wu and his bride use the deadly weapon - Phoenix Lute to fight against evil, but the lute accidentally falls into the hands of bandits hoping to use it to take control of the province. Gui Wu must now fight to recover the lute and beat the bandit

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本片是少林三部作的第三部。劉家輝仍飾演三德和尚,為要保護自持功夫了得便與大清高手結怨的少年英雄方世玉,差點也令少林寺陷入險境。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the finale of this trilogy, Gordon Liu reprises his famous role, Monk San Te, as he tries to protect Fang Shih Yu, an arrogant youth who gets into trouble with the Qing officials, and nearly lands Shaolin Temple into trouble too.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 幽默風趣的愛情喜劇,三個年青醫生常開道、史瑞科、蕭而可,被安排追求院長的三個女兒靈珍、靈珊、靈玲。三人以「包、剪、搥」來決定追求對象,他們的追女橋段層出不窮,用盡英雄救美、苦肉計、死纏爛打等愛情藥方,卻全部失靈,烏龍百出...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Three young doctors pursue three hard-to-get beauties in this romantic film set in the 70s “a-go-go” era. They have no idea where to start and use Rock-paper-scissor method to match themselves with the girls. The tactics and tricks they use are hilar

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 少林寺主持安排至善禪師前往武當道長處,學習獨特的功夫技能。在路途中,他遭遇了清兵與明軍之間的激烈鬥爭,同時還需召集少林弟子重建被燒毀的少林寺。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Monk Chi San is sent by his Shaolin Master to learn a special kung fu skill from a Wu Dang priest. He gets embroiled in a fight between the Qing and Ming camps along the way, and has to gather disciples to rebuild the burnt Shaolin temple at the same

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 時裝設計師史馬哥向葉德梅徵求她對自己作品的意見,梅卻隨意提出批評,這讓馬哥感到非常不滿。一天,梅準備出席一場盛大的宴會,於是找馬哥為她設計禮服,不料他為報復故意設計了一件小丑裝,讓梅顏面盡失。最終,史馬哥卻很內疚並向梅道歉,兩人冰釋前嫌,並墜入愛河。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Fashion designer Shi asks his friend Mui to comment on his new design but is angered by her criticism. When Mui asks him to design a gown for her to attend a gala event, Shi takes revenge by making a clown costume instead. Seeing Mui’s embarrassment,

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 宋太祖趙匡胤之弟光義恃建國有功,囂張跋扈,逼殺南唐後主李煜,李之舊部李浪矢誓報仇。太傅陳搏因欲修煉成仙,必先得皇帝封誥,故與光義妥協,助其奪取帝位,事成後由光義祭天封為華山神仙。陳搏帶光義夜闖禁宮,弒兄自立,並殺死李浪等心腹大患...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The last ruler of Tang, Li Yao is deposed by Chao Kuang-jun, the founder of the Sung Dynasty. Unfortunately his actions unleash a new plague - his brother Kuang-yi - on the courts and his people. The marauding Kuang-yi rapes and plunders. As more peo

epg.programme_title_en: The Adventures of Emperor Chien Lung
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 乾隆為體察民情,撇下侍衛假扮商人微服出訪江南,期間得知衙門有貪官欺壓百姓,導致民不聊生。這時乾隆遇上一名清廉的賣菜青年,二人合力教訓貪官一頓。最後,青年更被獲封為皇帝的近身侍衛。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Emperor Chien Lung travels incognito to Jiangnan to review his people’s livelihood but soon discovers that corrupt officials are oppressing his people. The emperor meets an upright young man and they join hands to teach the corrupt officials a lesson

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 太湖決戰前夕,白水宮主人被東瀛劍客所傷。於是,他囑咐其弟寶玉代尋找解藥。途中寶玉偶遇關外的小公主,二人一見鍾情。但原來小公主的背後卻隱藏著一個重大陰謀…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Water Clan Chief is severely wounded by a samurai killer shortly before the annual duel at Tai Lake. He sends his brother Bao Yu on a long journey to find an antidote for him. On the way, Bao Yu encounters Little Princess and falls in love with her,

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 三十五歲的男教師林明娶了十七歲的女學生珍珍。兩人在同一學校上課,隱藏夫妻秘密。珍發覺林明常被女生包圍,而林又發現珍常被男老師追求,期間笑料百出。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事描述,土匪出身的軍人韓佩昌發動叛變,殺死師長楊宗,竊居其位,楊家只得長子大英一人逃出生天。大英志切報仇,結果未得手已告命喪;其好友陳風、梁國仁、傅全義、辛成決替其復仇…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Corrupt general Wang Li assumes power by killing his superior. The son of the murdered superior befriends four street performers called “The Venoms”, and they help him take revenge by posing as government officials offering a peace token to the corru

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 酷愛音樂的留學生李英偉臨危受命替老父接管公司,其嬉皮士形像為祖母不屑。李的公司職員林仲鵬乘機製造事端,圖謀奪取其總經理之職位。李之青梅竹馬朋友王鳳不忍見李受屈,化身金髮美人巧施妙計助他解困,自此李對此神秘女郎一見鍾情 。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Guitar-playing rich kid, Yang Fan, heads to Japan to join a rock n roll band where he soon finds himself competing for the affections of two beautiful girls.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事講述以「反清復明」為號召的天地會,恐被清廷一網打盡,遂將會員名冊分成兩份,送往機密地點。天地會中人紅娘子遇上剛直的失業捕快阿雲,邀其協助把名冊送到朱標的武館去,期間遇到聰敏的棺材舖夥計阿寸,發生連串笑料。及後紅被原為清廷走狗的朱所殺,雲為代紅執行任務,終亦重傷身亡。最後任務便落在阿寸身上,寸與朱
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The traditional lion dance has never looked so good as in Lion VS Lion which captures the most impressive sequences of lion dancing on film. Besides being loaded with enjoyable martial arts chicanery, film historians can revel because its also the f

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部喜劇描述鄉下人阿牛來港後,因生性戇直而經常被壞人利用。阿牛嘗盡低下層社會的人情冷暖,最後更被判入獄!究竟天生樂觀的他,能否吉人天相?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This side-splitting comedy sees naive Ah Niu headed to Hong Kong, where he is repeatedly exploited and taken advantage of, and eventually finds himself arrested and imprisoned! Can he survive difficult times and finally overcome adversity?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 申九蚣與黃飛鴻結怨後,設計陷害他及其弟子謀殺。幸得商人周立德相助,黃飛鴻才倖免於難,但他卻要在舞獅會時搶得丁財炮以回報周立德。面對各路武林高手,黃飛鴻最終能否完成任務?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As Shen and Wong Fei Hung’s relationship turns sour, Shen frames Wong and his disciple for murder. They are saved by a businessman Zhou, but Wong must win the Lion Dance Trophy to return Zhou’s favour. Can Wong Fei Hung defeat all skilled martial art

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 話說醫務署發覺聖慕倫醫院的醫療水準及設備大有問題,原來該院院長體弱多病,院務交陳醫生主理;但陳個性主觀,行事不依規章,連手下一班見習醫生亦各具「特性」,時鬧笑話,弄至院務混亂。院長決定聘用資深護士長進行改革...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: At St. Morant Hospital, a harried but lovely administrator must deal with lusty interns, student nurses, a delirious surgeon, a dissection fiend, a criticizing Commissioner and gross negligence at regular intervals! This comedy is based on the hugely

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一幫土匪帶著劫來的保險箱到某小鎮,迫鐵匠韋開箱,韋卻逃走報官。匪幫濫殺村民,多名義士聞訊,聯手對抗眾匪。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A group of bandits flees with a stolen safe to a village where they oppress the villagers and force the blacksmith Wei to unlock the safe. Wei refuses and flees to report to officials, while heroes of the town emerge to fight the bandits.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 影后李菁的代表作,蕭湘反串文必正,傾慕官府小姐霍定金,賣身混入霍家,二人私定終身,必正被陷害入獄,定金設法營救...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Huangmei Opera tradition, this movie tells the love story of Wen, who sells himself as a slave to a rich family, and Huo, the family’s young daughter. The lovers are kept apart by Huo’s stepmother and Huo escapes by dressing up as a man. Wen is fr

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 太師之子在陳州貪贓枉法,私吞皇糧,被包拯當場斬首處死。太師知道後大怒,並令人刺殺包拯,幸得展昭及時阻止,救回他一命。皇上的珍品被偷的同時,宮中又發生謀殺案,於是,皇上限定包拯要在十天內破案。展昭馬上出發搜捕兇手。包拯和展昭最後可否如期破案?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The son of the imperial teacher is beheaded by Justice Bao for corruption. Infuriated, the teacher hires assassins to kill Bao, who is saved by Zhan Zhao. Meanwhile, a royal treasure is stolen while a murder takes place. Bao is ordered to solve the c

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 許珮青和夏夢軒在宴會相識,因彼此同樣經歷不幸的婚姻,兩人更一見留情。夏夢軒在一次海灘漫步,拾起紫貝殼給珮青留念。許珮青丈夫發現二人關係後,故意傷害她,使她病體支離,同時又勒索夏夢軒。這段愛情故事最後將如何收場?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Hui and Ha are stuck in their unhappy marriages and are attracted to each other when they meet at a party. In one of their beach strolls, Ha picks up a purple shell and gives it to Hui as a memento. When Hui’s husband finds out about them, he hurts H

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 蘇燦是酒莊老闆的長子,生性瀟灑不羈,在被學校開除後,被迫接受家中安排的私人教師指導。沒想到這位教師竟是一位身懷絕技的武術大師,蘇燦因此拜入其門下,展開嚴格的修煉。然而,當家人與師父慘遭冷血悍匪「蜈蚣」殺害後,蘇燦踏上了一場生死難料的復仇之路。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Su Can, the carefree yet unruly eldest son of a winery owner, is forced to study under a tutor after being expelled from school. He soon discovers that his tutor is a martial arts master and becomes his disciple. However, when his family and master a

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 有才華的女藝員蘭蘭與梅梅新加入「馬氏歌舞團」,蘭蘭與團主馬英不和。馬英在報紙匿名徵求女友,蘭蘭與他以匿名用書信往來,互生情愫。相約見面時,兩人膽怯退縮。歌舞團獲邀到日本表演,由馬英帶領,蘭蘭擔任女主角,二人的關係可否趁機會發展?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Acknowledged as one of the greatest Hong Kong musicals, this lavish movie starring Linda Lin, who won Best Actress for her performance, infuses its wispy plot with style and wit, and the results are pure pleasure.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 天宮仙女七妹嚮往凡間生活,某夜偷駕祥雲下凡來到香港。初到人間的她人生地不熟,險遭不法之徒欺騙,幸得經營負債累累孤兒院的董自立相救。面對貪婪富商覬覦院址、步步緊逼,七妹屢施法術相助,卻屢遭誤解為妖魅。兩人在困境中互相扶持,情愫漸生,共同守護孤兒院的未來。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Seventh Sister, a curious fairy from heaven, descends to 1970s Hong Kong. Lost in an unfamiliar world, she is rescued by Tung Chi Lap, who runs a debt-ridden orphanage. When a tycoon plots to seize the land, she uses her powers to protect it, and an

epg.programme_title_en: Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers?
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 三對年青男女出海渡假,忽然聽到新聞報導:一個穿紅色比堅尼泳衣的女郎一連殺了十三人,並正駕駛著快艇逃亡。正在此時,一個美的女郎破浪而來,身穿紅色比堅尼。女郎要求跟他們同上島避風。當晚,女郎的挑逗令眾男女之間產生前所未有的衝突... 電影未到最後一分鐘,不知結局。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 朱國棟和李明珠本打算結婚,無奈雙方父母為多年死對頭,所以堅決反對婚事。於是二人不惜假裝自殺。有見及此雙方家長最終冰釋前嫌,答應二人成婚。此時,唱片公司宣佈會為出棟的歌曲版,最終可謂雙喜臨門。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dong and Chu plan to get married but their families who are lifelong rivals, disapproved. They decide to fake suicide and eventually get both of their parents to settle their differences and approve the marriage. Concurrently, a record company announ

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 戴天仇自幼習武,矢志為父報仇。彼時其殺父仇人,到處為非作歹。戴上路途中遇上女扮男裝的吳小燕,並突遭多名幫會中人毒打,吳遂求父允其把戴帶返家中養傷。戴竟因此得以混入仇人地盤,希望可乘機報仇...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dai Tian Chou practices martial arts since young so he can avenge his father’s death.  He meets Wu Xiao Yan who is disguised as a man one day and is suddenly beaten by a group of gangsters. Wu begs her father to allow her to take Dai back home to rec

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事描述,每逢恐怖歌聲出現,必有閻家的人被署名「玉羅剎」者所殺。由於「玉羅剎」神出鬼沒,鬧得滿城風雨。冷秋寒于酒館遇見徐英豪,交談下,知彼也為尋仇而來;冷直告自己實為「玉羅剎」,殺閻家為替全家報仇,徐勸其勿濫殺無辜,冷不聽...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A fearsome swordswoman known as The Jade Raksha appears in the martial arts world and begins killing people whose surname is Yan. A swordsman figures out who she is and asks her why. Apparently a Yan killed her family 18 years ago and she only has ve

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 王昭君拒絕賄賂畫師,於是一直被畫師畫醜致未被皇帝看上。但皇帝初遇昭君後,驚為天人,即選中她。畫師被逐後,為報復而設計將昭君與匈奴可汗和親。皇帝因拒絕婚事即引來兩國爭戰,以致王昭君最後為了平息戰亂不得不犧牲自己。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wang Zhao Jun refuses to bribe the imperial painter, so he draws an ugly portrait of her, preventing her from being selected by the Emperor until they meet in person. The painter ends up in exile and plots for Wang to marry the Hun’s warlord as a rev

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 蘭嶼紅蟲為患,島上人只信大頭目及巫醫巴達兩人。年青醫生何維德到蘭嶼找尋曾到此研究紅蟲而失蹤的父親,因而與未婚妻白丹娜鬧翻。後來何與孤女雅蘭相愛,惹來西呼達嫉妒;同時何為島民治病,令巴達信眾日減,西呼達、巴達均伺機殺何,何身陷險境而不自知……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dr. He moves to the remote Lanyu island off the coast of Taiwan to look for his long lost father, and starts to run a clinic curing islanders who are bitten by the fatal red worms there. He meets Ya Lan who works as a nurse in his clinic and falls in

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 俠女花碧蓮愛上鄰村的駱宏勛,其父花振芳去說親,卻遭駱母拒絕。碧蓮深心不忿,找上駱家,把宏勛打倒來消氣。後碧蓮為救人而得罪賭棍萬三句,萬率眾圍殺碧蓮,幸宏勛及時趕來相救。萬之主人王倫知悉一切後,重金收買知府,將宏勛打下冤獄。碧蓮往探監,見宏勛奄奄一息,遂隻身闖進王倫練武場,大戰眾強徒,並取下王倫助手首
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Hua is an upright and brave swordswoman who will stand up against villains and do anything for Luo, the man she loves. When Luo is sent to jail by the corrupted police, she sets out to free him and did not hesitate to chop off two bodyguards’ heads.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在河北省某貪汙成風的小縣內,流浪漢甄明與賈亮因掌握一眾縣官的貪汙和醜聞證據,得以順水推舟假扮縣長,把各官員玩弄於股掌之中,峰迴路轉,結局卻出人意表。全片除帶出人生如戲的黑色幽默,也狠狠地鞭撻為官者殘民以自肥的無恥行為。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The roguish scamp Zhen and his best friend Chia collects proof of corruption from the officials in this comedy-drama. After a string of blackmailing, they end up in positions of power, but what is to happen next?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 十八年前,胡斐之父胡一刀,與苗人鳳交換刀劍比武,被己刀傷,繼而身亡,原來胡之刀早被田歸農塗上毒藥;苗妻南蘭被田勾引,竟拋夫棄女,后田更以毒粉弄瞎苗雙眼;斐見苗受此遭遇,決定代其向藥王求救,亦因此碰上一生中最愛的藥王傳人程靈素……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young man, Chin, believes he is an orphan, until he meets three men and learns from them that his father was a great swordsman who was killed when he was trying to dispel rumors of a wrongdoing and return a lost sword to its rightful owner. Chin se

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 白衣大俠和黑色醉俠同時愛上女俠金燕子。三人卻聯手對付江湖中的惡勢力。在一場生死對決展開前,金燕子還是遲遲未能作出自己感情的抉擇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A heroine finds herself in a love triangle with a swordsman and a warrior. They team up to conquer the evil forces of the martial arts world but she is unable to choose between both men even as they face a deadly duel.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廣東十虎之首的鐵橋三為人景仰,擁有徒弟無數。當時達官貴人都以吸食鴉片為時尚,而鐵橋三亦隨俗吸食,身子因此漸受毒害。後來,鐵橋三更被煙館主人擊敗,幸得徒弟捨身相救,他才不致喪命。於是,鐵橋三決心戒掉鴉片,重新振作。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tie Qiao San, head of the Ten Guangdong Tigers, is an honourable master with many disciples. As opium becomes popular among the nobles, Tie starts taking it and gradually harms his body. When an opium house’s owner defeats Tie in a fight and he is on

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 聞蜚蛾自幼女扮男裝從父習武,後更考得秀才功名,堪稱文武全才。同窗好友杜子中與魏撰之雖與蜚蛾日夕相對,均不知其是女兒身。聞母見女兒年紀不小,不該再扮男裝,勸蜚蛾選撰之或子中為夫婿。不料蜚娥與二人情誼相同,一時無法抉擇,遂決定由天定奪,怎知陰差陽錯,選婿之箭落於撰之手中。蜚娥後悔不已,才知自己意屬子中…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A charming Huangmei Opera title, this is the story of Fei E, a General’s daughter who grows up fooling everyone that she is a boy, including her two closest schoolmates. When she has to choose one of them to marry, how will Fei E tell them that she i

epg.programme_title_en: New Tales of the Flying Fox
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事講述了號稱打遍天下無敵手的苗人鳳,與大俠胡一刀不打不相識又識英雄重英雄,在比武過程中中了奸計,苗誤殺了胡,胡妻亦為夫殉情。兒子胡斐長大後誓要報仇……斐先後邂逅袁紫衣,程靈素二女,發展一段無私的三角戀。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a great rendition of The Silver Fox and Legend of the Fox comes this exciting adventure, where the only thing between the clan leaders and certain death is Hui Ying-hung.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事講述女俠俞飛霞,被武林盟主誤會她是运用「黑沙掌」,偷去神功寶書的幪面少女。於是她女扮男裝,混入少林寺暗中查探真相...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The heroine Yu Fei Xia is accused of stealing the book of martial arts secrets. To prove her innocence, she disguises herself as a man and finds her way into the Shaolin Temple to find out the truth…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 三國時代,道士于吉憑藉精妙的道術醫好無數病人,深受百姓愛戴。不料,「小霸王」孫策認為于吉妖言惑眾,遂下令把他斬首。怎料于吉練成道術,被斬後,他的元神脫體飛出並向孫策報復。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 正氣凜然的劍客白一鵬向「冷血五祖」報仇,卻遭追打至殘廢。數年後,一位年青人巧遇躲在洞穴裡的白一鵬,白一鵬亦決定將追風劍法傳授給這位堅毅的年青人,以助他向「冷血五祖」復仇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A righteous swordsman, Bai Yi Pang, seeks revenge on an evil clan but is crippled after being beaten up by them. Years later, a young man encounters Bai who is hiding in a cave. Bai decides to teach this determined young man his Swift Sword skills so

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 窮書生林肇德與富翁女兒訂親,但富翁因其家道中落而反對婚事。為迎娶摯愛,肇德上京考取功名,臨行前會晤未婚妻,怎料卻碰上婢女滿身鮮血伏屍後花園。因不慎留下血手印於門上,他更被誣陷殺人。直至包公及時重審,為他洗脫冤情。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Poor scholar Lin is engaged to a wealthy family’s daughter, but her father looks down on him due to his family’s background. Before leaving for the Imperial Examination, Lin visits his fiancée, only to discover a maid dead in blood. When his bloody h

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 明惠帝被篡位後,太子被藏匿在武林義士的黑龍會中,卻被武林敗類所襲擊,迫使入世未深的劍客及俠女帶著太子逃亡。他們一路上危機重重,幸得其他義士拔刀相助……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After the Ming Emperor is overthrown and his infant son was put in the care of the Black Dragon Society, a traitorous martial arts clan attacks the society, forcing an inexperienced pair of swordsman and swordswoman to flee with the infant. Their jou

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 金小芳是一位活潑且無畏的鄉村少女,面對惡霸從不退縮,總是勇敢反抗。當她揭露了唐家大少爺的陰謀後,立刻引來他的狠毒報復。幸好,她心儀的男子大海及時挺身而出相救。兩人能否攜手對抗險惡命運,改寫結局?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Fang is a spunky young village girl who is not afraid to fight back against hooligans. She gets into trouble with the biggest hoodlum Tong when she foils his plans with a maid, causing Tong to plot a revenge. Luckily a man whom she is attracted to, H

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 劇情描述楊過逃離全真教,誤打誤撞與小龍女相遇。二人在古墓生活,本為融洽;後小龍女為師姐李莫愁所傷,更遭尹志平迷姦。小龍女誤以為失身於楊過,遂提婚議,楊過不知就裡加以婉拒,小龍女悲憤離開古墓。楊過四出訪尋,終與小龍女重逢;惟重提婚事,卻為黃蓉勸阻。小龍女為不讓師徒戀損楊過聲譽,悄然出走...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Yang Guo and Xiao Long Nu are deeply in love and live harmoniously in the ancient tomb. Xiao Long Nu proposes marriage one day but Yang Guo declines. Heartbroken, she leaves without a word. Devastated by her absence, Yang Guo searches tirelessly for

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事描述,青年漁夫魯金虎與漁女小玉自幼相好;土豪獨子耀祖,垂涎小玉美色,時藉故親近;一天耀祖欺負寡婦五嫂,金虎抱不平,幾動武,惹小玉誤會金虎與五嫂有不尋常關係…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young fisherman, Chin Hu is in love with his childhood friend Hsiao Yu. However, the only son of a town bully lusts after Hsiao Yu’s beauty and tries all possible ways to approach her. Chin Hu  protects another woman from the bully one day, leading

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 武功高強的遊俠兒遊戲人間,劫富濟貧,往往連自已的銀子都散給災民。一日,他遇上一班強盜,打算搶劫一個正在保運一批價值連城珍寶的護衛。最初遊被他們欺騙一起劫鏢,但他在發覺後誓要進行報復。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The wandering swordsman Yu Hsieh Erh has formidable sword skills and helps the poor by robbing from thieves and distributing the wealth. He meets a group of bandits who are planning to rob a convoy escorting some valuables and is tricked into partici

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 妖精白素貞跟妹妹青青在凡間巧遇前世救命恩人書生許仙,後更以身相許給許仙。後和尚法海揭穿其身份並把這對苦命鴛鴦拆散...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Linda Lin Dai is perfect as Pak Su-cheng, the stunning snake goddess who assumes a womanly form so that she can taste the pleasures of a human life! Pak seduces young scholar, Hsu Hsien when she recognises him as her saviour in another life 1,000 yea

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一位功夫師傅與三位門徒被惡霸欺淩,師徒俱敗於他拳下。三徒悲憤填膺,分別尋師學藝。半年後,惡霸壽辰之日,三徒連袂回歸,誓要與惡霸一較高下!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A kung fu master and his three students lost everything after they are floored by a bully. To take revenge, the students find ways to learn from other kung fu masters and come back six months later to have a rematch with the bully on their master’s b

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 的士司機阿發與少女阿霞相愛已久,但發有神經錯亂,霞為除心理負擔,忍痛分手; 發大鬧霞家並斷指示真心,令霞感動而復合。然發卻不務正業,令霞甚為反感;一次爭執間,發狂性大發,霞流產,再次離開發...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Fa is an obsessive man who loves his wife Ah Hsia but is easily jealous and abuses her. When she leaves him one day, Fa hooks up with another woman, Hsing. A deadly triangle develops when Fa runs into Ah Hsia again and decides to win her back…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 高氏五兄弟,少時家遭巨變,流離失散。長大後,各有際遇,不知殺父仇人就是無惡不作的騰龍莊主。但五兄弟各自均不滿騰龍莊欺淩弱小之所作所為,並誓要除魔。當五兄弟重逢後,他們一起努力練功,準備與騰龍莊莊主及其幫會一戰。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The five Kao brothers, separated since birth, are unaware that the master of Teng Lung Manor has killed their father. All five however, vow to defeat the vicious gangsters at the manor due to their bullying ways. After reuniting and with much discipl

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 泉州才子陳伯卿,邂逅潮州第一美人黃碧琚,心生傾慕;後伯卿得知兩人幼時曾定親,於是隱瞞身份,賣身黃府,作陪讀書僮,以接近碧琚。陝西巡撫之子林大雄,垂涎碧琚美色,強自下聘,欲娶之為妻;碧琚父貪財怕勢,不理家人反對,收下林家聘禮。伯卿得知碧琚已有婚配,刺激過度,一病不起…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 花花公子周國雄有一本「獵人日記」專門去記錄他四出獵艷的故事,周丟棄劉明華,又去追獵呂綺美,劉突然遭人殺死。後來周又去追求女學生朱麗珍…但當晚,呂遭殺死,警方向周追查。同時周想到和他親近的女人,一個一個的被殺死,嫌兇漸指向他,好像有人在陷害自己。周開始追查真相。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tycoon Zhou is a playboy who is engaged to be married, but that did not keep him from working his charms on as many ladies as he can. He keeps a diary about his romantic escapades and soon, the women with whom he has been intimate with are being murd

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 唐僧師徒西行取經,受阻於烈火綿延的火焰山,唯有鐵扇公主的芭蕉扇方能滅火。然而因紅孩兒一事,牛魔王夫婦拒不相助。孫悟空遂與二人展開「三調芭蕉扇」的智勇較量。越過火焰山後,師徒不幸落入白骨精姐妹設下的長生圈套。面對詭計多端的妖精,悟空再施神通,護師脫險。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本片是少林三部作的第二部,講述劉家輝飾演的周仁傑一心要去少林寺學功夫,最後竟扮成寺中的三德和尚,並創出「搭棚式」的少林武藝。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The second film of the trilogy, Gordon Liu plays Zhou Ren Jie, a man who impersonates a monk in order to learn kung fu in Shaolin, and eventually creates his own Shaolin style of ‘scaffolding kung fu”.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: A sweet inn-keeper’s daughter is witness to a perverted rape, leading to more danger than most romantic dramas can handle. Can her true love rescue her in time? For this movie, the moonlight serenade is the sound of suspense, leading to more danger t

epg.episode_synopsis_en: When super director Chang Cheh found new talent and blood with The Five Venoms actors, most of which were trained in the highly acrobatic Chinese opera and well versed with exotic martial arts weapons, this created a new spark for his use of bizarr

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 魔術師陳子新和歌女張曉萍一次避雨,誤闖豪華大宅,曉萍被屋主以爲她是失散孫女,對她甚爲喜愛,可是引起富豪外甥不忿,設計害子新和曉萍。萍將計就計,把陰谋揭發,成功成立了歌舞團。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Hong Kong rhapsody is a musical extravaganza full of song and dance! Peter Chen-Ho stars as a playboy magician who changes his ways after he becomes the guardian of a young singer (Li Ching), the daughter of a deceased magician friend.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 集賢武館主人平伯被日高手谷嵐所殺,其子鐵娃入山投靠大舌頭,與大之女紅蝴蝶相處甚歡。時穀之子剛自日學成歸來,挑撥大熊與鐵。後熊與剛決戰死於暗算;鐵與紅得悉,下山報仇...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A vicious Japanese judo expert wants to prove that Chinese are the “sick people of Asia” and sets out to sabotage and kill the best martial artists in dangerous tournaments. To save his son from this, the head of Ping Pai Boxing Institute sends him t

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 酷愛音樂的留學生李英偉臨危受命替老父接管公司,其嬉皮士形像為祖母不屑。李的公司職員林仲鵬乘機製造事端,圖謀奪取其總經理之職位。李之青梅竹馬朋友王鳳不忍見李受屈,化身金髮美人巧施妙計助他解困,自此李對此神秘女郎一見鍾情 。

epg.episode_synopsis_en: A professor’s assistant stole a micro-film storing the secret of a newly invented nuclear reactor and sells it to a crime syndicate. However, the micro-film accidentally falls into the hands of a nightclub dancer and a thief in the process, leading t

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Si Si, a spoiled and naive rich girl with only basic kung fu training, becomes enchanted by the legends of the fearless hero Qin Ge. Determined to escape her father’s arranged marriage, she disguises herself as a man and sets out to find him, hoping

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 俠盜金毛獅武功高強,經常劫富濟貧。一夜他遭黑幫突襲,幸遇太湖七獅,把他送往神醫處救治。神醫攜金毛獅赴回魂谷採藥治傷,卻屢遭黑幫追殺,險象環生...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Golden Lion is a bandit with good martial arts skills and often robs from the rich to help the poor. He is ambushed and attacked by a gang one night but luckily finds help from a master healer, who has to find a way to treat him while they are bo

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Alfred Cheung Kin-ting returns to the screen with this seriocomic look at the clash of cultures which result when a Mainland Chinese peasant brings his family to Hong Kong. Family Light Affair, whose Chinese title literally translates as City Lights

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 年輕刺客青面修羅接受人生首份刺殺任務,同時暗中調查當年自己家族滅門慘案幕後起因。但任務還未完成,他發現自己已經捲入了一場策劃多年的陰謀當中,唯有利用自己的刺客技能,一一破局。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young assassin is assigned his first mission while secretly investigating the cause of his family’s massacre years ago. During the mission, he finds himself entangled in a political conspiracy that has been planned for years and must use his skills as an assassin to face whatever comes his way.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 真人秀節目The Ultimate BROcation,跟隨四位不同國家的藝人玩轉男人遊樂之旅 - 香港,盡情狂歡並展開瘋狂野性的冒險,為觀眾們帶來充滿男性狂野魅力的視聽享受!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A hilarious reality show about four famous male celebrities from different countries on an all-expenses-paid fantasy vacation in Hong Kong, tailor-made for the “bros”!

epg.programme_title_en: The Gangster, the Cop, the Devil
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 佛山刑警林岩成立精英專案小組,專門重拳打擊囂張跋扈的街頭飛車大盜及其幕後龐大的犯罪集團。然而,當他身懷六甲的妻子慘遭猖狂飛車賊蓄意撞擊,生死未卜之時,極度悲憤的他意外揭開了一場隱匿在黑惡勢力深處的兇險..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Detective Lin forms a special task force to crack down on violent motorbike robbers terrorising Foshan and expose the syndicate behind them. However, when his pregnant wife becomes a victim during a brutal attack, Lin uncovers a ruthless conspiracy driven by revenge, pushing him into a dangerous battle against criminals with nothing to lose.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Extreme Ends是個動作冒險真人秀節目,邀請四位名人及其特別嘉賓一同體驗香港的多元魅力!讓我們與馬來西亞的得獎女演員Siti Saleha 及其丈夫一起探索香港的白天与黑夜,感受這座城市充滿活..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Extreme Ends is an action-adventure reality show featuring four celebrities and their special guests experiencing the diversity of Hong Kong! Join award-winning Malaysian actress Siti Saleha and her husband as they explore the city by day and venture into the night, discovering its vibrant culture and hidden treasures.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 1917年,少年葉問初到香港求學。英文演講比賽當天,學校發生一宗驚天綁架案,全校同學都被挾持。面對眼前的危機,葉問挺身而出,發現綁匪竟然是自己的師父和好兄弟。少年葉問在危機時刻可否打敗綁匪,從而伸張正..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set in 1917, young Ip Man pursues his studies in Hong Kong. The school is held hostage on the day of an English speech competition, and as Ip Man decides to step up and fight the crisis, it is revealed that his master and his childhood friend are behind all this. Can he take them down and uphold justice?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當天才駭客Tara試圖阻止一個擁有自我意識的強大人工智能接管全球軍事系統時,她反被人工智能定性為必須剷除的恐怖分子……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When expert hacker Tara tries to stop a powerful and sentient A.I. from taking over the worlds military, the A.I. marks her as a terrorist who must be exterminated…

epg.episode_synopsis_en: After treating a boy injured in a hit-and-run, ER doctor Attila is drawn into East L.A.’s underworld conflict. The boy is the son of a crime lord, and the “accident” was gang revenge. To save his sister from prison, Attila becomes a drug courier, igniting a gang war that forces a tragic choice.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Erin, a troubled young woman with trauma and anger, travels to a remote estate to meet her boyfriend’s family. The visit turns into a nightmare when she discovers they are part of a blood cult. Abducted and marked for harvest, Erin unleashes a deadly rage, turning the hunt into a brutal fight for survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 赤練君在押解過程中逃脫,張道長亦因此被逐出師門。為追查赤煉君的下落,張道長來到一個地方,發現有很多平民無故失蹤。當張道長查出赤練君為練成蛇魔而抓走平民後,一場人魔大戰旋即展開。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Prisoner Chi flees away under Master Zhang’s custody, causing the latter to be expelled from his clan. On his way to find Chi, Master Zhang arrives at a place where many people vanish for no reason. He soon discovers that it is Chi who captures them in his training to become a serpent demon. The war between human and demon has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 急診醫生Attila救治一名車禍男童後,意外捲入洛杉磯東區的黑道糾紛。男童竟是黑幫頭目的兒子,而車禍則是預謀的幫派復仇。為救涉案的妹妹免於牢獄之災,Attila被迫成為黑幫的運毒棋子,由此引發一場血腥..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After treating a boy injured in a hit-and-run, ER doctor Attila is drawn into East L.A.’s underworld conflict. The boy is the son of a crime lord, and the “accident” was gang revenge. To save his sister from prison, Attila becomes a drug courier, igniting a gang war that forces a tragic choice.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Demon cult prevails in the Yun Sheng dynasty. The Emperor arranges the princess to marry General Bai Yi before he dies, but the princess wants to end her engagement. When the princess eventually falls for Bai, she is kidnapped by the demon cult and Bai is killed in a fight while trying to save her. Will the couple be separated forever?

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Legendary sniper Ghost Hand is hunted by the Yi He gang that is responsible for safeguarding the city. Lu Lan joins the gang to take revenge on Ghost Hand who has killed his brother. After training to become a top sniper, Lu Lan uncovers the true identity of Ghost Hand during a shootout and uncovers the conspiracy of Yi He gang.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Exorcist Liu Yi Ze proposes marriage to his girlfriend, but discovers that her family is manipulated by the Fox Demon. During his fight with the Fox Demon who has possessed his masters body, Liu Yi Ze must defeat the Fox Demon without hurting his master. Can he vanquish the demon and safeguard everyone?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 雷霆安保公司的幽靈小隊,由林森帶領隊友執行解救女科學家南茜的任務。眾人救南後在撤離時見到一名小孩被關在籠裡,趕去營救,卻聽到槍響,之後全軍覆沒。於偉剛寫下小說“幽靈狙擊的一段,跟著一聲槍響,被擊中頭..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lin Shen leads the insurance company’s ghost team to save a scientist. During the mission, they discover a child trapped in a cage but are ambushed on their way to the rescue. As Yu Wei writes the final paragraph of his novel “Ghost Sniper”, he is shot in the head. It is not until he wakes up that Yu Wei realises he has become his novel’s character!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 百年前,仙劍門祖師爺張掌門與異人首領幽皇大戰七天七夜,最終打敗幽皇,並將異人族兵器「九黎」封印。百年後,仙劍門弟子張之霖成為新掌門。此時發現鎮上女人離奇失蹤,原來是幽皇吸食女人精魄練就神功。仙劍門布下..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: 100 years ago, Master Zhang triumphed over Inhuman clan leader, Emperor Yu, in a fierce 7-day duel and sealed their weapons after that. A century later, Zhangs disciple, Lin, assumes leadership and discovers that the spirits of the vanished women are devoured by Emperor Yu for boosting his power. The war between good and evil has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一列載著淘金夢開往上海的列車突然脫軌墜崖。吳天等一行人倖免於難,卻遭到蜈蚣攻擊。隨後他們逃進了一個怪異村莊,而古怪的村長對這幫各懷鬼胎的倖存者起了殺心。突然成群蜈蚣傾巢而出,在村中大開殺戒。吳天等..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A train carrying gold rushers derails and falls off the cliff. Wu and other passengers survive, but are attacked by centipedes. Subsequently, they escape to a village. With the village head trying to kill them and the centipedes attacking at the same time, can Wu and other passengers escape the disaster? What is the secret of the village head?

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lu and Da are assigned to protect a military officer, but he dies suddenly. As Lu investigates, he finds a dance girl and her brother suspicious, and the brother suddenly goes missing. Lu, Da and the dance girl find themselves involved in a conspiracy and after much investigation, Lu finds the culprit and unravels the secret of a hidden treasure.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在蘅王統治下民不聊生,有志之士誓要推翻蘅王,立下衣帶詔。蘅王請魏侯爺找出衣帶詔,並要派殺手殺死名單上所有人。白山水和謝柔均在名單上,而謝柔的弟弟謝長勝對白心生愛慕,與其他殺手一路追蹤白到客棧。..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Under the oppressive rule of Emperor Heng, some volunteers sign on the Belt Oath to overthrow the government. The Emperor sends killers to eliminate them, including Bai Shan Sui and Xie Rou. Xies brother falls for Bai, so he follows the killers to the inn, but ends up causing a series of hilarious events due to misunderstandings.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 茍勝、富貴等人突然在酒店遇到由食物引起的病毒爆發,感染者失去理智,瘋狂地撕咬其他人。茍勝帶領眾人逃離酒店,前往安全地方,在逃亡過程中與感染者發生了激烈搏鬥。隨後逃亡隊伍內部又突爆矛盾及衝突,互相猜忌。..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Gou and his friends encounter a food virus outbreak at the hotel, which causes infected people to bite others insanely. Gou tries to bring his friends out from the hotel but this results in a fierce battle with those being infected. As conflicts and suspicions arise during the escape, can they finally reconcile and flee successfully?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 狐族女君九尾不幸落入梅山七怪老大猿猴精袁洪之手,陰差陽錯被姜子牙所救,卻被姜斬斷一條尾巴。九尾走投無路在女媧娘娘的指點下附身在冀州候蘇護的女兒蘇妲己身上。不久,紂王攻打冀州,妲己被俘,及後紂王娶了妲己..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Nine-tailed Fox is caught by the seven monkey monster in Mount Mei. Jiang Zi Ya inadvertently saves Nine-tailed Fox but cuts off one of her tails, making her so desperate that she possesses the body of Da Ji. Shortly after, Emperor Shang invades Ji Zhou and kidnaps Da Ji, who later becomes Empress Shang and causes chaos throughout the realm.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Innocent City is built on an isolated island with no laws set in place and many criminals go there for shelter. Tang, of the special forces, is trapped by Solan during his mission, and though he escapes, he is poisoned and has few hours to live. As Solan also kills Tang’s wife and kidnaps his daughter, Tang embarks on a road to revenge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 亂世末期,商朝遭到周武王的進攻,被周軍將領楊戩打得節節敗退。軍師申公豹向紂王建議招攬梅山七怪助商攻周,因為七怪之首袁洪與楊戩一樣精通八九玄功可七十二變。紂王命申公豹立刻前往梅山將七怪納入麾下。於是,楊..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Emperor Zhou Wu has defeated the Shang empire with General Yang defeating the Shang army. Military advisor Shen advises Emperor Shang to recruit Seven Monsters with mystic skills to attack Zhou, so Emperor Shang orders his general to find Seven Monsters in Mountain Mei. The battle between Zhou and Shang has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a crime-ridden world, there remains a town safeguarded by the private heroes from the triads. Wu Zheng Yi practises kung fu everyday and finally becomes a private hero with the help from Xiong. When Wu discovers that the private heroes are controlled by the evil gang, he teams up with his master Xiong to vanquish the evil gang boss.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the battle between human and demons, human race leader, Huang Di, restores peace by magical astronomy and establishes the Wu Yin Sect. During an  escape, Detective Zhou encounters the dying Wu Yin Sect boss, who passes on his martial arts skills to Zhou. With the help of the sect, Zhou finds his inner power to defeat the demons.

Zhengs true motive is to uncover the tombs hidden treasure and he also enlist the help of Chen. Together, they embark on a perilous expedition to hunt for the treasure as well as to help the people.

They decide to contain the enemys artillery supply to reduce casualties, and vow to dedicate themselves to fight against the foes for their people.

The governors henchman assigns a squad to eliminate witnesses and erase all evidence. Despite facing his best friends death and his mothers captivity, Fang vows to fight against the forces of evil.

As ill-intentioned martial artists arrive to uncover the treasure, Cop Lin, assigned by the mayor, teams up with a death row inmate to identify the murderer and uncover the truth, so as to safeguard the town and its people.

In a fight between Du and his daughter on the roof, they accidentally got struck by lightning and discover that they have swapped identities after regaining consciousness!

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In future earth, humans emit exhaust gas to produce waste, leading to earths desertification. Desert Bugs are mutated to cause human extinction and the last hope of the survivors is to find the oasis. A team made up of tycoons, scientists, security chiefs, engineers and gangsters embarks on a perilous journey in an armoured tank to find the oasis.

Fu Cha is tasked by the Emperor to investigate, so he enlists the help of Su Can, who uncovers a brutal assassination plot involving illusions and unravels the secret behind the case.

As Justice Bao, Zhan Zhao and Gong Sun Ce secretly preside over the trials involving evil spirits, the disciples of “Wai Jiu Liu” try to poison Bao and hedge a huge plot. How can Justice Bao tackle the plight?

One day, they receive an anonymous order to protect An Nings sister, who since then has frequent accidents. While Tong unveils an organization specializing in accidental homicide, who wants to kill An Nings sister?

Both team up to investigate a series of bizarre cases, to uphold justice and to maintain order amidst a social upheaval.

Ya Mei sneaks in and helps her teammates to escape by setting off a bomb, at the same time faking the death of herself and her fiancée. Three years later, Mei must resume duty to fight against Ba Song in order to save her kidnapped fiancée.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tian Yi is destined to fail as an immortal in heaven. When he accidentally frees Snowy and makes her a demon, he wanders in hell for thousand years to right his wrong. After a series of hardships, Snowy and Tian Yi manages to get married, but the heavenly warriors attempt to arrest Snowy. Can the couple live happily ever after?

His three kids, each of distinct character, get involved in the plan. The family join hands to defeat the enemy, but at the same time, also making troubles for themselves.  As the situation spirals, the ending ia anyones guess.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大唐盛世時期,曲江池天降妖龍異象,導致長安百姓一夜禿頭,令聖人勃然大怒。黃河縣令王玄秘密調查此案,發現背後竟有人密謀屠城計畫,影響到聖人安危。王玄深入偵查龍王教,過程中破解了金鯉迷局,更識破了屠城計畫..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set in the Tang dynasty, a fallen demon dragon causes the people of Qujiang City to mysteriously go bald overnight. Outraged, the Emperor assigns Magistrate Wang to investigate the case. Wang infiltrates the secret Long Wang Cult and exposes their plot to instigate a massacre, eventually saving the emperor and protecting the people.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大清年間,偏遠的臨江縣有兩名縣令接連被大蟒蛇咬死,百姓人心惶惶。侍衛蘇乞兒和鐵橋三奉命前往臨江縣調查此案。兩人發現當地毒品極樂丸極為盛行,而在調查當中鐵橋三與蘇乞兒也因極樂丸陷入困境。在逆境面前他們不..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: During the Qing Dynasty, two magistrates died from a deadly snake bite, causing fear amongst the people. When two imperial constables investigate the case, they discover that a Happiness drug is commonly abused in town. Despite facing many difficulties during the investigation, they strive to bring the mastermind to justice.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 普光市內有一羣犯罪團夥“門徒無惡不作,參與多宗販毒走私傷人案件。一天公安局接到門徒內部人員詠琳的舉報,局長找來打黑大隊長唐飛帶領警員對門徒進行深入的調查。他們要利用黃金72小時對門徒展開一次性的肅清..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A group of criminals joins the Disciple gang to engage in drug trafficking, smuggling and assault in Pu Guang City. One day, the police receives information from an undercover of the gang, and Inspector Tang is assigned to lead a thorough investigation. They must disintegrate the gang in 72 hours for the peace and harmony of Pu Guang City.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 趙子龍在常山歸隱七年後,因戰亂變故流落到鄴城與劉備及趙雲重逢。趙子龍終究被劉備的仁義所折服,在劉備與眾人的鼓勵及殘酷現實的鞭策之下,逐漸找回自我與理想,再次號召眾兄弟並肩作戰,最終在長阪坡大敗敵軍,成..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After hiding in Mount Zhang for seven years,  Zhao Zi Long reunites with Liu Bei and Zhao Yun. Persuaded by Lius righteousness, Zhao rediscovers his aspirations and rallies his comrades to battle their enemies at Chang Ban Slope. He eventually defeats the enemies and emerges as the Great General of the Han Dynasty.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 年青鐵匠呂三思偶遇自己崇拜的大俠百里無憂。他幫助大俠押送西廠走狗何清纓,但何卻對他說了另一個版本的故事,說她是被西廠迫害,而百里才是出賣義士的走狗!事情越來越可疑,何不一定是走狗,而百里也可能不是大俠..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Young blacksmith Lui encounters his idol, Swordsman Bai Li, and helps Bai deport He Qing Ying, a lackey of the emperors secret agency. However, He claims that she is innocent while Bai Li is the one who has betrayed the patriots. Things become suspicious and Lui is unsure of whom to trust. Who will he trust in the end?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 張君佳是一名高中學生,為了接近校花黃巧姍,他想拍一部微電影,讓黃巧姍主演。藝術節快要到來,他決定組織同學們拍一部校園喪屍片,拍攝期間,眾人幾經波折,劇組更瀕臨於崩潰邊沿。然而友情、親情和愛情交織成的共..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Zhang Jun Jia directs a micro movie starring the school girl he likes. As Arts festival approaches, Zhang and his classmates decide to make a college zombie movie. They encounter many difficulties in the process and despite the production team falling into pieces, they manage to overcome the challenges with love amongst friends, family and lovers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在無人區的荒野裡正發生著一場驚險的生死追蹤。少年堇言意外拍下了盜獵者襲擊警方的場面,不幸被歹徒發現後擊傷了堇。他忍耐著疼痛一路逃走,其後這幫人還挾持堇的姐姐樸雨。兩姐弟在無人區裡奮力逃走,憑藉著堅強意..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A fatal pursuit happens in a no mans land. Young Jin Yan accidentally captures the scene of a poacher attacking a cop, and the villains attack and injure him when they discover his act. As Jin tries to escape, they kidnap his sister as well. Jin and his sister must strive to escape from the villains and bring them to justice.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 宋遼太平時期,原本是秘密組織“鳳火軍培養的特工唐紫煙被安插在京都皇城司任職。正當唐紫煙想悄悄退出,與丈夫過上平靜的餘生時,丈夫卻被鳳凰火軍帶走來威脅唐接受新任務,刺殺來訪的北朝特使皇太弟。唐決心脫離..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Agent Tang is trained by the secret society to work undercover in the imperial government. Tang wants to quit for a peaceful life with her husband but is forced to kill the Imperial Prince when the society holds her husband hostage. Tang resolves to break free and joins forces with the Imperial Prince to destroy the society and restore peace.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 為了取長補短,陳真遠赴日本學習工業技術。留學期間,陳真與擅長形意拳的武術家薛自立一起,為了捍衛中國人民的尊嚴,他們勇敢面對日本軍部官員的比武挑戰。一場中國功夫大師與日本武士的較量正式上演,比武場上陳真..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When Chen Zhen travels to Japan to learn industrial technology, he teams up with martial artist She Zi Li, and accepts a duel challenge from the Japanese military officials to uphold the Chinese dignity. In a battle of Chinese kung fu master agianst the Japanese samurai, Chen showcases the unique finesse of Chinese kung fu.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 少男曾為獲得格鬥冠軍的哥哥少北為驕傲,以為有哥哥在便能永遠保護自己,可以像少年時一樣無憂無慮。最終哥哥在衝刺世界格鬥冠軍擂臺上身受重傷意外身亡。格鬥公司創辦人丹姐訓練少男幫助他復仇,而少男亦替少北贏回..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Shao Nan is proud of his brother Shao Bai being the combat fighting champion. When Shao Bei died after being seriously injured in a fight, the founder of the fight company decides to train Shao Nan for vengeance. Shao Nan eventually rises to become the next champion, fulfilling his brothers last wish and make Asians proud.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國時期,一代奇人關師爺行走江湖,巧遇狐妖鬧事。關師爺與狐妖鬥法,過程中認識了逢賭必輸的葉飛。此事過後,關師爺又巧妙化解了一樁青樓恩怨,為死去的冤者伸冤,卻再次與怪事纏身的葉飛相遇。之後二人攜手與妖怪..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Republican period, demon catcher Guan meets Ye Fei, a gambler who always loses, when he fights against the fox demon. Guan meets the troubled Ye Fei again after he resolves a case involving innocent deaths in a brothel, and they team up to successfully fight against the demons and evil spirits with their wit and bravery.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 毒梟塚虎在十五年前派人追殺梅姨,當時林郎與林峰親眼目睹母親梅姨被殺害,為躲避殺手追殺,郎與峰分頭走散,但郎之後音訊全無,而峰成為緝毒員警。在中國邊境滇市的掃毒行動中,峰發現毒梟郎哥的母親也是被塚虎殺害..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lin Lang and Lin Feng witness their mothers murder by the drug dealer Tiger fifteen years ago. They separated in their escape and Feng becomes a narcotics police officer while Lang disappears. In an operation, Feng discovers that Tiger has also killed the mother of a drug boss, Lang. Is Lang his brother? Can Feng arrest the drug dealers?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 剛建成的洛陽宮夜裡被一條神龍縱火焚燒,木匠不是死就是失蹤。狄仁傑破格升任大理寺少卿查案,卻遭神秘勢力阻撓。他憑線索及隱士李先生的指點找到了關鍵人物宮少爺,也在紅顏知己柳月如協助下摧毀了機關基地。關鍵時..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The newly completed Luo Yang Palace is set to fire by the Fire Dragon, resulting in the carpenters being missing or dead. Detective Dee is tasked to investigate the case. He finds the cases key person, demolishes a secret base with his best friend Liu, and kills the Fire Dragon, vowing to uncover the truth.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一心想要去學習嶗山道法的少年王生,終獲高人指點,學成歸家,之後卻把師父“不可生邪念的教誨丟在腦後,學了點法術便打算用來行竊。隅然王解開了自己身世之謎,又經過幾番歷練才終於開悟,決定用屬於自己的方式來..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Young Wang Sheng aspires to learn Laoshan Taoism skills. Under the tutelage of his master, Wang acquires the skills but succumbs to greed, forsaking the masters teachings of Think No Evil. As Wang finds out about his own identity, his epiphany sparks enlightenment, prompting him to forge his unique path in vanquishing the demons.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 北魏時期柔然軍入侵邊境,花木蘭為老父出征,女扮男裝入伍來到邊關要塞常平倉。木蘭在戰場上奮勇殺敵,屢建戰功,取得多次勝利。正當眾人歡慶之際,敵人將數量足有百萬隻老鼠投入城中,趁亂攻城,令他們受到重創。為..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mulan disguises herself as a man to join the army on behalf of her elderly father. She fights gallantly and vanquishes her enemies in rounds of battles. While they celebrate their victory, the enemy sets millions of rats into the city, followed by a raid. Mulan fearlessly defends the city, risking her life to ensure the peoples safety.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 武則天時期,京城長安接連發生了好幾次離奇死亡案件,因為死因不明,以致忠烈祠飛天壁畫顯靈殺人的謠言愈演愈烈,百姓紛紛認為是天降不祥,人心惶惶。在地方屢破奇案的狄仁傑奉命調查此案,最終不僅破除了謠言,也通..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: During the era of Empress Wu, rumours about mysterious murder cases are spreading in Chang An City. The people are worried and see it as an ominous sign. Detective Di is assigned to investigate the case, and not only did he manage to unravel the mystery, he also uncovers the truth and finds the culprit.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 金傲為保護中華傲決與無敵大戰,在生命垂危的時候將中華傲決傳授給華英雄。然而擁有“天煞孤星命格的華英雄失去了父母及妻子,離開了兒女,潛心修煉二十年卻始終無法參悟中華傲決。最終,華為了所有中國人要與無敵..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jin Ao battles with Wu Di to preserve the Pride martial arts skill, which he passes to Hero Hua before he dies. Hua, who is born under the curse of the Star of Loneliness, leaves his family to practise the martial arts skill for 20 years, but still fails to master it. Can Hua finally master the skill and defeats Wu Di to save his people?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 黃河邊的一個小村落,有一口浮棺出現後,村中怪事頻發。撈屍人趙家帶人下水查探,但只有家主一人生還。多年後浮棺再現,千年巨蛇亦浮出水面,趙家後代趙佰用祖傳秘術來對付巨蛇。另外陳家因盜墓受到詛咒,壽命很短,..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A floating coffin triggers a series of disasters in the village and only a member of the Zhao family survives. Years later, the coffin reappears with a serpent and a Young Zhao vows to kill it. Meanwhile, the Chen family is cursed and it can only be broken by the floating coffin. This results in the two families teaming up in a dangerous adventure.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 傅炎為了拯救瀕臨死亡的藍墨伊,毅然前往上古戰場神佑之地,尋找神炎來救藍。上古戰場分三層,他們剛從外層降服了守護獸赤墨玄蛟時,便遇到蒼岩宗宗主蒼石靈君。然而傅及石二人要爭奪對方的半張藏寶圖,在一番激戰後..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: u sets out to find the Godly Flame and save the dying Nan. On his way, he encounters Master Shi of Can Yan Sect when vanquishing a guardian beast. Fu and Shi battle for their respective halves of the treasure map but eventually reconciled after a fierce fight. Both decide to share the map and team up to search for the treasure and the Godly Flame.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 青山大學著名植物學教授霍玉春研發出一種可以讓植物與動物DNA相結合的新病毒。此時女學生羅柯向教授的助教鄭問表白,兩人墜入愛河之際,病毒突然在學校中爆發,柯不幸受感染被隔離。為了拯救學校及柯,鄭問找到教..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Huo, a famous university botany professor, uses animal and plant DNAs to develop a virus. His assistant, Cheng, falls in love with his student, Ke, but Ke gets infected during a sudden virus outbreak in the university. To save Ke and the university, Cheng stumbles upon the professors secret laboratory and unveils a secret between Huo and Ke.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個佛與魔較量的故事。為阻止上古妖魔羅剎降世,將世間顛覆成萬劫不復的寒冰煉獄,少林寺弟子慧海踏上了尋找降龍羅漢之旅。青梅竹馬的上官靈素始終陪伴守護慧海,不畏困難,幫助慧海破除心魔,參透少林精神,最終憑..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a battle between Buddha and Devil, Shaolin disciple Hui Hai embarks on a journey to find Luo Han to stop the demon from turning the world upside down. Accompanied by his childhood friend, Hui is fearless and masters the Shaolin spirit. Eventually with the Shaolin skills, they banish all demons and restore peace to the world.

Accompanied by his childhood friend, Hui is fearless and masters the Shaolin spirit. Eventually with the Shaolin skills, they banish all demons and restore peace to the world.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Trapped under Mount Wuzhi for 400 years, the Monkey King is saved by Ah Yi, but is targeted to be assassinated under the Prince Dragons orders. Though the mission fails, Ah Yi is captured and Monkey King battles the Prince Dragon across land and sea to rescue her. He finally redeems himself and returns to Mount Wuzhi to continue his training.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: To stop the Japanese pirates and find his missing friend, the Ming dynasty Marine Officer Lin Xiao joins the Marine General to embark on a treasure hunt. On the way, they encounter a mysterious sea monster as well as the pirates. Lin must join forces with the marine team to battle against them and accomplish their mission.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 南宋末年,國家陷入內憂外患的局面。狄族聯合魔教,妄想踏平中原稱霸江湖,危難之際,無極派大弟子張君寶又名張三豐挺身而出,協助朝廷擊退敵軍,卻不料師門慘遭魔教血洗,死傷慘重。為了振興門派,保衛家園,張毅然..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tribe Di join forces with the Demon Cult to rule the martial arts world. Zhang San Feng, a disciple of Wu Ji Clan, helps the government to fight the rebels but this results in his clan suffering heavy casualties. To save his clan and his homeland, Zhang sets out to destroy the Demon Cult but gets entangled in another conspiracy in the process.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國初年,生物研究所得知在沙海有異變生物,於是派出探索小隊前往調查,但前去的隊員幾乎全部被滅,剩下劉夢西和夏萱帶著生物樣本逃離,過程非常危險,幸得獲沙丘鎮柳纓所救。原來沙漠出現異獸,居民被迫在地底生活..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Institute of Biology assigns a team to investigate the mutants in a desert, but the whole team is nearly wiped out. Luckily, two researchers escape with the mutants samples. As the residents in the desert are forced to live underground to avoid threats by the mutants, the team must beat the mutants for survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 以前的扶風城晚上花燈特別閃耀,尤如白天,然而現在卻被黑暗籠罩,更流傳著“點燈殺人的傳說,以致城中百姓晚上也不敢點燈。溫寧到城後,發現了很多反常之處,後來更遇到藍氏子弟藍思追,倆人為了還百姓一個太平安..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lanterns once illuminated Fu Feng City at night, but it is now shrouded in darkness as there is a rumor that people will get killed when their lights are on. When Wen Ning discovers anomalies in this situation, he joins forces with Nan Si Zhui to find the real culprit behind and finally restore peace and harmony to the city.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在剿滅東南亞最大的犯罪組織救世會時,金泰在任務中誤殺了自己的師傅金銘。泰極度自責,默然離開特工組織。然而消失多年的救世會再次出現,泰更得知組織的頭目竟是死而復生的銘,令他一蹶不振,直到一個男孩的出現,..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Secret agent Tai accidentally kills his master Ming, as he tries to destroy a powerful criminal gang. Tai is so guilty that he decides to leave the agency, but the gang with Master Ming as its head, reappear years later. Devastated by his masters deception, Tai returns as an agent to settle their grudges after being inspired by a young man.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 武周時期,禦史中丞胡顯德一家被殺,武則天派狄仁傑前往調查。狄調查發現,原本老實本分的胡離奇般參與了一場大案,此案可能是一宗案中案。在查案過程中,狄不斷遇見各種詭異事件,更有陰兵索命的傳言,案件一籌莫展..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Detective Di Ren Jie is assigned by Empress Wu to investigate the massacre of Minister Hus family. In the process, he uncovers Hus involvement in a criminal case and encounters spooky incidents, as well as rumours of vengeful killing by hell guards. Di delves into the heart of the perplexing mystery, unravelling the truth behind it.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the early 1910s, four performers embark on a perilous journey to an ancient tomb in search of their missing master. Inside the tomb, they encounter various difficulties and experience life and death. In the process, they also discover a mysterious treasure in the tomb and unveils their masters secret.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 唐德宗元年,道士預言黑蛟即將面世危害百姓。這日呂姓書生坐船東渡去找白瑛退婚,到達後發現白的父親失蹤,白也被傀儡化,而他亦遭到襲擊。書生逃脫後,遇到太白金星被告知他是被打入凡間的呂洞賓,前世今生黑蛟都是..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A Taoist prophecy foretells that the rise of Hei Jiao will threaten the world. As Scholar Lu Dongbin is on his way to end his marriage engagement to Bai, he finds her father missing and Bai possessed. As Lu learns about his immortal identity, he realizes that the encounter with Bai and the incidents that happened are all part of his destiny.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In 1928 Shanghai, a new triad gang plans to expand their territory, causing conflicts with the old triad gang. As the son of the old triad boss seeks revenge for his fathers death, he accidentally makes friend with the new triad boss right-hand man. However, as the two are destined rivals, a fatal battle between them is inevitable!
