epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 來到幕後,了解那些致力於保育與保護肯尼亞野生動物的創新團隊.看看「拯救大象」組織的無線電追蹤項圈系統,監測野狗群的無人機,以及當地的馬賽獵豹追蹤團隊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Look behind the scenes and meet the innovative teams working to preserve and protect Kenyas wildlife. Check out Save the Elephants radio-tracking-collar system, a drone that monitors wild dog packs, and a local team of Maasai cheetah trackers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與自然界中最狡猾和堅韌的戰士一起部署生化武器.釋放科莫多龍的毒咬,與獴群一起抵抗有毒的敵人,並觀察鳥類如何使用骨骼粉碎的力量來反擊有毒攻擊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Deploy biochemical weaponry with natures most cunning and resilient fighters. Unleash venomous bites with Komodo dragons, resist poisonous foes with mongoose mobs, and see birds use bone-crushing force to counter poisonous attacks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 前排觀看地球上最大規模的生物量遷移,即每年沿南非東海岸1000英里的沙丁魚風暴.數十億條小魚倉皇躲避著饑餓的捕食者,其中包括隱秘的海豹和潛水炸彈般的塘鵝.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get a front-row seat to the planets biggest biomass migration, the annual 1,000-mile sardine run along South Africas east coast. See billions of these tiny fish run a gauntlet of hungry predators, including stealthy seals and dive-bombing gannets.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟随團隊的腳步,從囤積的病人中分診患者,隨後與救援人員喬 (Jo) 和尚特爾 (Chantelle) 一起解救糾纏在一起的朱鹮.與獸醫梅爾 (Mel) 一起檢查一隻跳水的考拉寶寶,並與一條致命的東方棕色蛇玩伺機而動的遊戲.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Chase the team as they triage patients from a hoarding case, then free a tangled-up ibis with rescue officers Jo and Chantelle. Check on a baby koala that took a swan dive with vet Mel and play the waiting game with a deadly eastern brown snake.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿曼達和到訪的獸醫蘇菲竭力讓一頭斷腿的長尾猴有機會重返野外.阿爾瑪接收了一頭特殊的孤兒 - 像貓般的獛屬,和一頭反社會的狒狒,也有機會加入部落.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: See Amanda and Sophie push boundaries to get a vervet monkey with a broken leg back into the wild, the team is challenged when collaring a four-ton elephant. Alma receives an orphaned, cat-like genet and an antisocial baboon rejoins a troop.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿曼達和文迪施展渾身解數來幫助一頭被捕網抓獲的鬣狗; 一頭獅子威脅村莊; 團隊釋放13隻猴子的計劃因最後一刻的手術而受阻;還有一些狡猾的逃生藝術家.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join the rescue as Amanda and Mandy try every trick in the book to help a snared hyena, a lion threatens a village, and the teams plan to release a troop of 13 monkeys is thwarted by last minute surgery and some crafty escape artists.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 來到幕後,了解那些致力於保育與保護肯尼亞野生動物的創新團隊.看看「拯救大象」組織的無線電追蹤項圈系統,監測野狗群的無人機,以及當地的馬賽獵豹追蹤團隊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Look behind the scenes and meet the innovative teams working to preserve and protect Kenyas wildlife. Check out Save the Elephants radio-tracking-collar system, a drone that monitors wild dog packs, and a local team of Maasai cheetah trackers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​體驗超越人類能力的動物技能.看看鹹水鱷魚如何利用其壓力敏感的圓頂檢測最微小的動作,發現鴿子的內部GPS系統,並利用第七感與海豚一起檢測獵物.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 加入尋找庫伯鷹的行動,牠剛剛在後院的泳池裡驚險的泡了個澡.捕捉救援中心臭鼬的狂歡,但牠們似乎不願出鏡,這讓拍攝團隊有機會近距離體驗臭鼬的自然防禦能力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join the search for a Coopers hawk whos taken a dangerous dip in a backyard pool. Catch the hijinks of the centres skunks as they try to avoid getting their shots, giving the team a closeup experience with the animals stinky natural defences.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 今集動物朋友仔中,一頭被救出的犀牛孤兒跟一隻貪玩的小狗和一隻充滿愛的綿羊成為朋友,一隻大兔子照料一頭精力旺盛的小羊,還有一隻箭豬幫助兩隻英國鬥牛犬為受傷動物復健.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode of Amazing Animal Friends a rescued orphaned rhino befriended by a playful dog and doting sheep, a big bunny rabbit that babysits boisterous baby lambs, and a porcupine that helps two English bulldogs rehabilitate injured animals.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 尼華保育區正在努力讓大象由肯雅山經過桑布魯國家公園回到野外.他們還創造了一個大象禁區,試圖恢復受損的生態系統.無線電跟蹤項圈用於幫助環保學家更好地瞭解大象的需求,並觀察牠們是否正返回棲息地.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lewa Conservancy is working to return elephants to territory from Mt. Kenya to Samburu National Park. Theyve also created an elephant exclusion zone to try and restore a damaged ecosystem. Radio tracking collars are used for both initiatives to h...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 肯雅禁止獵象40年.有組織的武裝偷獵集團仍然染指大象,非法捕獵並在黑市出售象牙.環保主義者和保育人士正在發出警報.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Elephant hunting has been banned in Kenya for 40 years. Organized gangs of armed poachers are still targeting elephants, illegally hunting them and selling their ivory tusks on the black market. Environmentalists and conservationists are sounding ...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 細紋斑馬數目在不到20年間下降了一半.環保學家指出若我們不警惕,牠們可能會徹底絕種.尼華保育區是保護牠們的核心,讓牠們的數量能回升.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Grévys zebras population has dropped by 50% in less than 20 years. Environmentalists say that if we arent vigilant, they could disappear all together. Lewa Conservancy is at the heart of efforts to protect the species so that they can replenish ...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 肯雅不斷增長的人口正從野生動植物手上奪取土地和資源.擠擁正造成越來越多人與動物間的衝突,這是非洲保育最大問題之一.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kenyas growing human population is taking land and resources away from wildlife. The squeeze is creating increasing numbers of conflicts between humans and animals, and is one of the biggest issues in African conservation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 肯尼亞邁出了重要的一步,在桑布魯區中心地段開設第一個社區經營的犀牛保育區.非法武裝偷獵團對肯尼亞犀牛的威脅達到40年來最高,這讓保育區更顯重要.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kenya takes a major step with the opening of its first community-run rhino sanctuary in the heart of Samburu territory. The threat to Kenyas rhinos from armed, illegal poaching gangs is the highest its been in 40 years, which makes the sanctuary...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 肯尼亞的捕獲隊伍前往索馬里邊境捕獲50隻被稱為亨氏牛羚的珍稀瀕危羚羊.在過去十年中,亨氏牛羚的數量一直急劇下降,保育組織知道通過捕獲並將它們置於受保護的零捕獵者保育區,有助數量回升.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Capture teams from Kenya head to Somali border to capture 50 rare and endangered antelope called a hirola. The hirola numbers have been plummeting over the last decade, and conservation groups know that by capturing and placing them into a protect...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與位處北方的科學家團隊一起熬夜,他們嘗試為一隻公牛鯊裝上追蹤儀,看看這頭夜貓子入夜後有何行蹤.然後與南方團隊一起潛入80米深的海底,並嘗試為一條雌性大白鯊裝上衛星追蹤器.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stay up late as the northern team attaches an activity tag to a bull shark and finds out what this night owl does after sunset. Then dive 80 meters deep with the southern team, who are hoping to put a satellite tracker on a female great white.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨北方研究團隊窺探鯊魚的社群層級結構,他們正在研究年輕的黑鰭鯊如何學習社交和生存技能.然後與南方團隊會合,一同前往彩虹海灘,他們渴望目睹沙虎鯊最難以捉摸的行為:交配.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ponder shark community hierarchies as the northern team studies how young blacktips learn social and survival skills. Then rush to Rainbow Beach with the southern team, who are eager to witness the sand tiger sharks most elusive behaviour: mating.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探索澳洲超級鯊魚大道的盡頭,了解南方的格林利島是否大白鯊遷徙路線的中途站,然後尋找北方牛鯊與生活在較冷氣候的表親,以及他們之間的基因聯繫證據.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Travel to the ends of Australias shark highways. Find out if Greenly Island in the south is a truck stop for migrating great whites, then search for proof of a genetic connection between northern bull sharks and their cooler-climate cousins.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨南方團隊測試新的追蹤鯊魚技術和工具,可望減少在熱門浮潛地點的鯊魚攻擊.然後與北方團隊一起追蹤牛鯊;科學家們希望幫助當地游泳者避開即將分娩的母牛鯊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow the southern team as they test new migration tech and tools that could reduce shark attacks in a popular snorkelling spot. Then catch and tag bull sharks with the northern team, who want to help local swimmers steer clear of birthing mothers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 前排觀看地球上最大規模的生物量遷移,即每年沿南非東海岸1000英里的沙丁魚風暴.數十億條小魚倉皇躲避著饑餓的捕食者,其中包括隱秘的海豹和潛水炸彈般的塘鵝.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get a front-row seat to the planets biggest biomass migration, the annual 1,000-mile sardine run along South Africas east coast. See billions of these tiny fish run a gauntlet of hungry predators, including stealthy seals and dive-bombing gannets.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 流浪雄獅最近的入侵將孟巴肯高獅群分散到了遙遠的南方,留下那些失去了首領- 叛逆者的保護,易遭攻擊的幼獅.現在旱季已經過了一半,炎熱的天氣降低了河水的水位,金巴和瑪雅兄妹倆冒險過河尋找父母.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After the dry season lowers the waters, siblings Kimba and Maya risk crossing the river to search for their parents. They run the gauntlet of the densest populations of crocs and hippos in Africa, and face an even greater threat on the other side.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​追溯獅子從史前掠食者到現代統治者的崛起,隨著科學揭示塑造這位標誌性非洲獵手的戰鬥,聯繫和殘酷生存策略.沉浸在獅子社會的戲劇和高風險狩獵的情節中.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Trace the lions rise from prehistoric predator to modern ruler as science reveals the battles, bonds, and brutal survival strategies that have shaped this iconic African hunter. Get swept up in the drama of lion society and high-risk hunts.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​面對海洋中最具多樣性和威脅性的掠食者.了解幫助這種史前物種在多次大規模滅絕中生存下來的生物優勢,然後驚嘆於公牛鯊無情的狩獵技巧.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Confront the oceans most versatile and formidable predator. Learn about the biological advantages that helped this prehistoric species survive multiple mass extinctions, then get awed by the relentless hunting skills of bull sharks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​重溫棕熊的進化之旅,從主宰冰河時期的熊科祖先到今天的現代雜食動物.見證它們與鮭魚之間的共生關係,以及它們所繁榮的驚人互聯生態系統.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Revisit the evolutionary journey of brown bears, from ursid ancestors that dominated the ice ages to todays modern omnivores. Witness their symbiotic relationship with salmon and the surprisingly interconnected ecosystems they thrive in.

epg.programme_title_tc: 飢餓遊戲:阿拉斯加的大熊挑戰 #1
epg.programme_title_en: The Hungry Games: Alaskas Big Bear Challenge 1 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 七隻飢腸轆轆的大熊剛從冬眠中甦醒過來,挑戰隨即展開!一起見證新手媽媽如何與狼群作戰,身型細小的跺跺如何爭奪地盤和金鬆少女的愛,並旁觀老練的伯尼如何與出其不己的少年卡薩諾瓦搏鬥.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wake up post-hibernation with 7 ravenous bears as Stage 1 of the competition kicks off. Battle wolves with new mom BoldFace, see tiny Stomper vie for power and Blondies love, and stand back as grizzled vet Bernie brawls with clueless teen Casanova.

epg.programme_title_tc: 飢餓遊戲:阿拉斯加的大熊挑戰 #2
epg.programme_title_en: The Hungry Games: Alaskas Big Bear Challenge 1 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與初賽的優勝者和一些強悍的新挑戰者一起投入這場瘋狂的衝刺,迎接他們的在七月洄游的鮭魚!跟隨大男孩踏上尋找美食之旅,並歡迎紅背兒參加盛宴;再看看新手媽媽能否保護她僅存的小熊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join the frantic dash to cash in on Julys salmon run with the Stage 1 winners and some tough new recruits. Tag along on BigBois food-finding road trip, welcome QuadMom and RedBack to the feast, and see if BoldFace can keep her surviving cub safe.

epg.programme_title_tc: 飢餓遊戲:阿拉斯加的大熊挑戰 #3
epg.programme_title_en: The Hungry Games: Alaskas Big Bear Challenge 1 #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 挑戰者一一提起精神,因為十月的寒流使局面變得更加複雜.看看大男孩在絆倒後如何重新振作,然後見證悲劇降臨四子之母.為粉絲最愛的新手媽媽和她的黏人的小孩加油.挑戰來到尾聲,誰會成為最終的皇者?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bundle up as an icy October storm complicates the race to the finish line. See Big Boi bounce after a stumble before tragedy hits QuadMom, and cheer as fan fave BoldFace hits her stride despite her clingy kid, Raccoon. But who will wear the crown?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部12集的紀錄片系列將顯示哪些動物居住在城市中,以及牠們遇到了甚麼麻煩.當牠們需要幫助時,一隊拯救隊將會出動.每年有成千上萬的動物獲得新生,只因志願者和專業人士一同為熱愛的大自然出力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When a baby mink is abandoned in a store, the team gets to work on some behavioural training. But will this sweet little one be tough enough for the wild when theyre done? Visit with a mange-afflicted coyote whos enjoying some alone time to heal.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 認識更多動物朋友仔,動物收容所的一隻小狗幫助被帶回的小獵豹為回到野外做準備,一隻受傷的猴子贏得一群冷漠狗隻的歡心,還有一隻喜歡與一群羊一起覓食孤獨的獴.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet more Amazing Animal Friends, an animal shelter puppy that helps a captive cheetah cub get ready for the wild, and an injured monkey who wins over a pack of unfriendly dogs and a lonely mongoose that enjoys foraging with a flock of sheep.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 數百萬年前,被遺棄的生物發現自己被困在馬達加斯加崎嶇的海岸上,與大陸隔絕,新來者唯有進化.這是一個神奇的世界,稀有而獨特的動物完美地適應了牠們的熱帶世外桃源.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Millions of years ago, castaway creatures were stranded on the rugged shores of Madagascar. Left to evolve on their own, theyve found a way to perfectly adapt to their tropical climate. Now, see what life is like for a family of ring-tailed lemurs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這島是狐猴的天地.狐猴是馬達加斯加迷人的樹棲原始靈長類動物,從最大的大狐猴到倭狐猴,各種大小,顏色和形狀都有.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The island is the land of Lemurs. Lemurs are fascinating arboreal primitive primates of Madagascar represented in all sizes, colors, and shapes from the largest Indri to the tiny mouse lemur.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 位於南非的霍格斯巴克,有兩種迷人的靈長類動物棲居其中:長尾猴和開普鸚鵡.窺探牠們如何克服棲息地日益萎縮的困境,並充分利用機會,穿越城鎮尋找食物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Hogsback, South Africa, is home to two fascinating primates: The Samango monkeys and the Cape Parrots. See how they overcome habit loss, travel across town for food, and make the most of a difficult situation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 貝拉貝拉狒狒隊伍是一個成功的查克馬狒狒族群,牠們在南非沃特伯格山脈的一個原始山谷中開枝散葉.但繁華背後卻有一個問題--牠們不是山谷中唯一的狒狒族群.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Bambelela Troop is a successful and gregarious troop of Chacma Baboons that live in a pristine valley in the Waterberg Mountains of South Africa. But they have a problem-theyre not the only baboons around.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在澳洲東南部大雪山的涼爽高地,有一片被稱為袋熊林的大型林地.在樹叢中點綴著茂密的樹葉,可看到過百個地洞,袋熊在白天溫暖時都躲於其中睡覺.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the cool highlands near Australias Snowy Mountains is Wombat Wood. There, dotted amongst the trees and dense foliage, are over a hundred wombat burrows. But when some of the burrows are flooded, the wombats need to find safety.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 袋熊通常是獨居和行動緩慢的動物,但袋熊繁殖時卻變了樣,有著十足精力,侵略性和大量遊玩時間.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wombats are solitary, slow-moving creatures, but breeding time brings out their energy, aggression and lots of play. Meet a southern hairy-nosed wombat named Birri, whos trying to find a mate, along with a female named Winnie and her joey, Fred.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是令人難以置信關於一棵樹的故事,它已存活了八百多年...能抵受最惡劣的環境...而且昆蟲,鳥類和動物更喜歡它...巨大的猢猻樹.它紮根於津巴布韋南部的馬里蘭威禁獵區的大草原.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This is the incredible story of a tree that has been around for eight hundred years... that can withstand the harshest conditions... and that is more loved by insects, birds and animals than any other...the enormous Baobab. Rooted on the savannah ...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 急診室團隊正忙著應對春季患者潮.在救援隊抵禦粗魯的袋鼠時,獸醫菲爾 (Phil) 穩定了一隻小袋鼠.高級獸醫蒂姆 (Tim) 為一隻被貓抓傷的袋狸治療,並從柵欄捉出一隻魚遊蛇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Scramble as the ER team tends to a spring flood of patients. Watch vet Phil stabilize an ailing joey as the rescue team fends off a rude kangaroo. Shadow senior vet Tim, who treats a cat-scratched bandicoot and snakes a keelback out of a grate.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與救援人員喬 (Jo) 一同去撈起一隻吞下魚鉤的鵜鶘,隨後看到山姆 (Sam) 解救了一隻纏在柵欄里的蝙蝠幼崽.跟隨獸醫蒂姆,他救助一隻眼睛感染且脾氣怪戾的考拉,並觀看一條笨重的蟒蛇給新手魯比 (Ruby) 帶來的麻煩.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Head out with rescuer Jo to scoop up a pelican whos swallowed a fish hook, then see Sam free a newborn bat tangled in a fence. Follow vet Tim, who aids a surly koala with an eye infection, and watch a lumpy python give newbie Ruby a load of trouble.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 影子獸醫貝克 (Bec) 為被狗咬傷的考拉瑞秋 (Rachel) 包扎傷口,新手獸醫魯比 (Ruby) 和克里恩 (Kerryn) 負責安撫一群不安分的負鼠.與救援人員丹妮 (Dani) 一起解救一對被困在墻上的笑翠鳥,並觀看獸醫蒂姆 (Tim) 為松鼠袋鼯進行的膝蓋手術.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Shadow vet Bec, who patches up dog-bitten koala Rachel, and new vets Ruby and Kerryn, who soothe a pack of itchy possums. Free a pair of kookaburras trapped in a wall with rescue officer Dani and watch vet Tims squirrel glider knee surgery.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟随團隊的腳步,從囤積的病人中分診患者,隨後與救援人員喬 (Jo) 和尚特爾 (Chantelle) 一起解救糾纏在一起的朱鹮.與獸醫梅爾 (Mel) 一起檢查一隻跳水的考拉寶寶,並與一條致命的東方棕色蛇玩伺機而動的遊戲.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Chase the team as they triage patients from a hoarding case, then free a tangled-up ibis with rescue officers Jo and Chantelle. Check on a baby koala that took a swan dive with vet Mel and play the waiting game with a deadly eastern brown snake.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 深入潮池世界,旁觀寄居蟹四處覓屋,小貓鯊遇見奇怪的鄰居,並見證章魚化身獵食者,令獵物聞風喪膽.在灼熱的日光下,池中氧氣逐漸耗盡,海鷗也看準時機,在水面上大快朵頤.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Descend into the tide pool, where a hermit crab house hunts, a baby catshark runs into strange neighbours, and an octopus terrorises prey. Watch seagulls and other creatures hunt on the surface as the heat rises and oxygen depletes in the pool.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 夕陽西下,掠食者在潮池邊伺機行動,只待潮水再度湧來.夜幕低垂,一隻愛偷竊的海蛞蝓與懂得翻騰兩周半的扇貝奮力求生;一對狡猾的螃蟹則挺而走險,展開一場充滿挑戰的求愛任務.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Count down the seconds as the sun sets and predators prowl around the pool before the tide finally rolls in. Persevere as night falls with a kleptomaniacal slug and an acrobatic scallop, while a pair of sneaky crabs take a dangerous shot at romance.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一群勇敢的雄性企鵝聚集在水邊,準備在岸上進行危險的旅程.面對前路的險途,數量多比較安全.這些小企鵝有著重要的任務,繁殖的時候到了,牠們必須在雌性到來前找到一個洞穴.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: At the waters edge a brave group of male penguins gather, preparing to make the dangerous journey ashore. With many threats ahead, there is safety in number and these petite penguins have important business to attend. Its time to breed and they ...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 紐西蘭的西岸不像世上任何地方.從冰川覆蓋的山脈到原始雨林,再到嚴酷的寒冷海域,壯麗景致令人難以置信.這片與世隔絕幾乎未被觸及的桃花園,隱藏著許多土生的動物.進化的漂流者,每一個都是罕見的生態瑰寶.從啄羊鸚鵡和害羞的企鵝到哺乳類般的鷸鴕和古老的鰻魚,為了於這種條件下生存,這裡的野生動物必須堅強,...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: New Zealands West Coast is like nowhere else on Earth. From glacier-covered mountains to rain-drenched native forests to rough frigid seas, the landscape defies belief. Isolated from the rest of the world, this strip of almost untouched wildernes...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 紐西蘭有兩個野生堡壘保護脆弱的土生動物:一個是受到鹽水護城河保護的偏遠島嶼,另一個是被防捕食者屏障包圍的山頂城堡.這是這些精緻的庇護所和在其中茁壯成長的動物的故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In New Zealand, two wild fortresses protect the vulnerable native animals: One a remote island protected by a moat of saltwater, the other a hilltop citadel surrounded by a predator-proof barrier. This is the story of these delicate sanctuaries an...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 紐西蘭東岸的春天是紐西蘭海狗和北方皇家信天翁的好時光.牠們已回到自己的土地準備繁殖.但因惡劣的地形,無常的天氣和飢餓的掠食者使牠們的生活變得困難.只有最強者才能生存下去,並薪火相傳下去.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Spring on New Zealands east coast is a time of promise for the New Zealand Fur Seal and the Norther Royal Albatross. Theyve returned to their land to breed. But harsh terrain, fickle weather and hungry predators will conspire to make lives diffi...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 紐西蘭與世隔絕的島嶼是不凡的天堂及家園,以擁有多元又獨特的野生動物聞名.尤以不會飛的鳥類,古代爬行類和沿海哺乳類最為人所共知,仔細觀察將會發現另一個世界.這裡有微型的怪物,小型的掠奪者和微小的恐怖,卻帶來了非凡的生命.每個獵人也是獵物,永遠需要努力生存.走進灌木叢,又會發現不同規模的生活.從巨...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: New Zealands isolated islands are famed as an unusual paradise, home to a variety of unique wildlife. Best known for its flightless birds, ancient reptiles and coastal mammals, a closer look reveals another world. A land of miniature monsters, Li...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 深入潮池世界,旁觀寄居蟹四處覓屋,小貓鯊遇見奇怪的鄰居,並見證章魚化身獵食者,令獵物聞風喪膽.在灼熱的日光下,池中氧氣逐漸耗盡,海鷗也看準時機,在水面上大快朵頤.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: A curious raccoon sticks his head a little too far into a peanut butter jar on a sweltering summer day in Toronto. See how the team gets him out of this sticky situation. Then cheer on a painted turtle who needs emergency eye surgery.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 向大自然中最古老,最致命的耐力型掠食者之一低頭致敬.看虎鯊如何利用海龜築巢時的混亂展開獵食,和肩章鯊一起在缺氧環境中生存,並和幽靈鯊一起承受深海驚人的高壓.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bow down to one of natures most ancient and deadly endurance predators. Watch tiger sharks exploit turtle nesting chaos, survive oxygen-poor environments with epaulette sharks, and withstand the crushing pressure of the deep with ghost sharks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟著各式各樣的鯊魚在海洋中巡游,看看為什麼這些掠食性魚類能夠稱霸海底世界.和礁鯊一起穿梭在珊瑚迷宮之中,和鬚鯊一起潛伏等待最完美的攻擊時機,並和大白鯊一起展開史詩般的大遷徙.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Prowl the ocean with sharks of all kinds and see why these predatory fish reign supreme under the sea. Stalk coral labyrinths with reef sharks, lie in wait for the perfect strike with wobbegongs, and embark on epic migrations with great whites.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​面對海洋中最具多樣性和威脅性的掠食者.了解幫助這種史前物種在多次大規模滅絕中生存下來的生物優勢,然後驚嘆於公牛鯊無情的狩獵技巧.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Confront the oceans most versatile and formidable predator. Learn about the biological advantages that helped this prehistoric species survive multiple mass extinctions, then get awed by the relentless hunting skills of bull sharks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 見證大白鯊群英的終極戰鬥!科學家們嘗試從新西蘭海岸外的100多條大白鯊中,挑選出領頭的鯊王.一起為群雄的速度,獵食技能和無比勇氣而喝采.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness the ultimate battle for dominance as scientists try to pick out the alpha male in a pack of 100-plus great white sharks off the New Zealand coast. Marvel at the speed, hunting prowess, and fearlessness that determine the leader of the pack.

epg.programme_title_en: Boss Shark: Battle of the Sexes
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​目睹一場前所未有,獨特異常的鯊魚競賽,巨白鯊在令人瞠目結舌,驚心動魄的力量比拼中正面交鋒.與鯊魚專家萊利•艾略特博士(Riley Elliott)一起冒險,他努力回答這個古老問題:究竟哪一性別才是海中最強者?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness a shark competition unlike any other, where great whites go head-to-head in jaw-dropping tests of strength. Risk it all with shark specialist Dr. Riley Elliott as he tries to answer an age-old question: Which sex reigns supreme?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在海陸相連的公園中,自然元素相互結合,創造出美妙的多樣性.可樂色的水使森林變得翠綠和茂密.火與風促進多樣性的增長,岩石形成了眾多面貌的海岸線.生命在這裡茁壯成長 - 從壯麗到奇異,這是花園大道國家公園.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a park where land meets sea, the natural elements combine to create wonderful variety. Cola-colored water feeds forests green and dense. Fire and wind fuel growth in great diversity and rock shapes a coastline of many faces. Life thrives here -...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 處理爭鬥的小鴨圍捕,看看獸醫卡琳娜 (Karina) 是否會請專家來治療考拉斯派克 (Spike) 的腿部骨折.深入了解困擾針鼴寶寶乒 (Ping) 和乓 (Pong) 的胃病問題,並遇到了似乎迷路了的考拉賈拉 (Jarrah).
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Deal with duelling duckling roundups and find out if vet Karina calls in specialists to treat koala Spikes leg fracture. Get to the bottom of stomach issues plaguing baby echidnas Ping and Pong, and meet koala Jarrah, who seems to have lost his way.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部12集的紀錄片系列將顯示哪些動物居住在城市中,以及牠們遇到了甚麼麻煩.當牠們需要幫助時,一隊拯救隊將會出動.每年有成千上萬的動物獲得新生,只因志願者和專業人士一同為熱愛的大自然出力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow the medical and rehab teams at Toronto Wildlife Centre as they work to clear a rescued fox of mange and return it to the wild. Elsewhere in the center, meet scores of injured songbirds that have hit downtown buildings on their way south.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​重溫棕熊的進化之旅,從主宰冰河時期的熊科祖先到今天的現代雜食動物.見證它們與鮭魚之間的共生關係,以及它們所繁榮的驚人互聯生態系統.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Revisit the evolutionary journey of brown bears, from ursid ancestors that dominated the ice ages to todays modern omnivores. Witness their symbiotic relationship with salmon and the surprisingly interconnected ecosystems they thrive in.

epg.programme_title_tc: 喀拉哈里: 秘密聯盟 #1 [英/普]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 認識在喀拉哈里盆地合力確保共存的罕有合作者.瞭解大象族群與結果白相思樹的共生關係,貓鼬與吵鬧卷尾鳥的聯盟,以及更多一對對動物相.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet the unlikely collaborators working to ensure mutual survival in the Kalahari Basin. Learn of an elephant clans symbiotic link to fruiting anaboom trees, a meerkats alliance with a feisty drongo bird, and more flora-and-fauna odd couples.

epg.programme_title_tc: 喀拉哈里: 秘密聯盟 #2 [英/普]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 喀拉哈里的動物們渴望雨水,因為牠們已經忍受了極端乾旱的一年.見證象群在拼命尋找水源時的合作,邂逅幫助小貓鼬生存的奇怪保姆.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Thirst for rain alongside the animals of the Kalahari, as they endure a brutally dry year. Witness co-operation between elephant herds in their desperate search for water and meet a meerkats strange babysitter, who helps the next generation survive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在克留格爾國家公園北部,賴以維生的元素就是水.在炎熱和乾旱的土地上,一條絲帶在荒野中切割出可靠的路線.它是不論大小所有生物的生命線.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the northern reaches of the Kruger National Park, life depends on one thing – water. In a land burdened by heat and drought a single ribbon cuts its reliable course through the wilderness. Its a lifeline to all creatures, great and small.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與大量被遺棄的考拉幼崽打交道,隨後與獸醫護士尼克 (Nick) 一起尋找治療小袋鼠腸道疾病的天然藥物.思考如何解救被困在樹上的蝙蝠寶寶,並觀看獸醫卡琳娜為一隻翅膀骨折的倉鸮進行手術.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Contend with a flood of abandoned koala joeys, then join vet nurse Nick on a hunt for natural remedies to treat a wallabys gut ailment. Ponder options for a baby bat stuck in a tree and look on as vet Karina operates on a barn owls fractured wing.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​目睹一場前所未有,獨特異常的鯊魚競賽,巨白鯊在令人瞠目結舌,驚心動魄的力量比拼中正面交鋒.與鯊魚專家萊利•艾略特博士(Riley Elliott)一起冒險,他努力回答這個古老問題:究竟哪一性別才是海中最強者?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness a shark competition unlike any other, where great whites go head-to-head in jaw-dropping tests of strength. Risk it all with shark specialist Dr. Riley Elliott as he tries to answer an age-old question: Which sex reigns supreme?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​重溫棕熊的進化之旅,從主宰冰河時期的熊科祖先到今天的現代雜食動物.見證它們與鮭魚之間的共生關係,以及它們所繁榮的驚人互聯生態系統.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Revisit the evolutionary journey of brown bears, from ursid ancestors that dominated the ice ages to todays modern omnivores. Witness their symbiotic relationship with salmon and the surprisingly interconnected ecosystems they thrive in.

epg.programme_title_tc: 喀拉哈里: 秘密聯盟 #1 [英/普]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 認識在喀拉哈里盆地合力確保共存的罕有合作者.瞭解大象族群與結果白相思樹的共生關係,貓鼬與吵鬧卷尾鳥的聯盟,以及更多一對對動物相.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet the unlikely collaborators working to ensure mutual survival in the Kalahari Basin. Learn of an elephant clans symbiotic link to fruiting anaboom trees, a meerkats alliance with a feisty drongo bird, and more flora-and-fauna odd couples.

epg.programme_title_tc: 喀拉哈里: 秘密聯盟 #2 [英/普]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 喀拉哈里的動物們渴望雨水,因為牠們已經忍受了極端乾旱的一年.見證象群在拼命尋找水源時的合作,邂逅幫助小貓鼬生存的奇怪保姆.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Thirst for rain alongside the animals of the Kalahari, as they endure a brutally dry year. Witness co-operation between elephant herds in their desperate search for water and meet a meerkats strange babysitter, who helps the next generation survive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在克留格爾國家公園北部,賴以維生的元素就是水.在炎熱和乾旱的土地上,一條絲帶在荒野中切割出可靠的路線.它是不論大小所有生物的生命線.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the northern reaches of the Kruger National Park, life depends on one thing – water. In a land burdened by heat and drought a single ribbon cuts its reliable course through the wilderness. Its a lifeline to all creatures, great and small.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與大量被遺棄的考拉幼崽打交道,隨後與獸醫護士尼克 (Nick) 一起尋找治療小袋鼠腸道疾病的天然藥物.思考如何解救被困在樹上的蝙蝠寶寶,並觀看獸醫卡琳娜為一隻翅膀骨折的倉鸮進行手術.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Contend with a flood of abandoned koala joeys, then join vet nurse Nick on a hunt for natural remedies to treat a wallabys gut ailment. Ponder options for a baby bat stuck in a tree and look on as vet Karina operates on a barn owls fractured wing.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 見證大白鯊群英的終極戰鬥!科學家們嘗試從新西蘭海岸外的100多條大白鯊中,挑選出領頭的鯊王.一起為群雄的速度,獵食技能和無比勇氣而喝采.

epg.programme_title_en: The Hungry Games: Alaskas Big Bear Challenge 1 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 七隻飢腸轆轆的大熊剛從冬眠中甦醒過來,挑戰隨即展開!一起見證新手媽媽如何與狼群作戰,身型細小的跺跺如何爭奪地盤和金鬆少女的愛,並旁觀老練的伯尼如何與出其不己的少年卡薩諾瓦搏鬥.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wake up post-hibernation with 7 ravenous bears as Stage 1 of the competition kicks off. Battle wolves with new mom BoldFace, see tiny Stomper vie for power and Blondies love, and stand back as grizzled vet Bernie brawls with clueless teen Casanova.

epg.programme_title_tc: 金伯利:澳洲的狂野西境 #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 沉浸在地球上最大,保存最完整的稀樹草原之中;在那裡,哺乳動物和昆蟲都能毫不費力地飛掠空中.了解傳統的野火管理方法,探索一處砂岩避難地,並看著一隻蜜袋鼯試著逃離火焰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bask in the largest intact savannah on the planet, where mammals and insects fly through the air with the greatest of ease. Study traditional wildfire-management methods, explore a sandstone refuge, and watch a sugar glider try to escape the flames.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 以澳洲最近發生災難性森林大火的後續,透過充滿希望,人為干預和復原力的故事,記錄野生動植物的長期恢復情況.本節目發放了一個十萬火急的訊息,不要太遲愛護大自然.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Examine fires pivotal role in shaping Australias natural world. Tour the devastation left by 2020s brutal bush-fire season, learn how climate change fuelled this watershed event, and chart the long-term recovery of the continents wildlife.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 偉大的奧蘭治河有著56米高壯觀的奧赫拉比斯瀑布.奧赫拉比斯源於「oukurubes」這個詞,在南瑪改的土著語言中意思是「雷霆之地」,這片土地是一個苛刻和陽光充沛世界的中心,充滿絢麗色彩和雷鳴般的咆哮.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In New Zealand, two wild fortresses protect the vulnerable native animals: One a remote island protected by a moat of saltwater, the other a hilltop citadel surrounded by a predator-proof barrier. This is the story of these delicate sanctuaries an...

epg.programme_title_tc: 金伯利:澳洲的狂野西境 #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 沉浸在地球上最大,保存最完整的稀樹草原之中;在那裡,哺乳動物和昆蟲都能毫不費力地飛掠空中.了解傳統的野火管理方法,探索一處砂岩避難地,並看著一隻蜜袋鼯試著逃離火焰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bask in the largest intact savannah on the planet, where mammals and insects fly through the air with the greatest of ease. Study traditional wildfire-management methods, explore a sandstone refuge, and watch a sugar glider try to escape the flames.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 以澳洲最近發生災難性森林大火的後續,透過充滿希望,人為干預和復原力的故事,記錄野生動植物的長期恢復情況.本節目發放了一個十萬火急的訊息,不要太遲愛護大自然.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Examine fires pivotal role in shaping Australias natural world. Tour the devastation left by 2020s brutal bush-fire season, learn how climate change fuelled this watershed event, and chart the long-term recovery of the continents wildlife.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 長頸鹿嬰兒遇上族群,動物園的五個水獺兄弟正在移動,冷血動物團隊正尋找隱藏的寶藏.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Baby Giraffe meets the herd, the Zoo’s five otter brothers are on the move and the ectotherm team search for a hidden for a treasure.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 動物園獸醫們在今集竭力拯救地球上最瀕危的鳥類之一,過程使他們十分焦慮;而冷血動物團隊正在野生的南島執行任務.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, its an anxious time for Zoo vets as they work to save one of the most endangered birds on the planet, and the ectotherm team are on a mission in the wild South Island.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 今集,動物園在沼澤森林歡迎兩隻鱷魚,新的東南亞棲息地開張,團隊準備為南方白犀牛寶寶慶生.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, the Zoo welcomes two crocodiles to the Swamp Forest, the new South East Asia habitat opens and the team prepare for the birth of a baby southern white rhino.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奧克蘭動物園的靈長類小組準備迎接新生.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Auckland Zoo’s primate team prepare to welcome a new birth.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們跟隨奧克蘭動物園的鳥類團隊進入科羅曼德山脈的荒野,他們協助拯救本土鷸鴕的數量.這是袋獾的獵食潮,大象團隊面臨至今為止最大的挑戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: We follow Auckland Zoo’s bird team into the wilds of the Coromandel Ranges as they help to save native kiwi populations, It’s a feeding frenzy for the Tasmanian devils and the elephant team faces their biggest challenge yet.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小企鵝史拿帕在今集回到領地,但牠會被接納嗎?獸醫團隊準備治療蘇門答臘虎沙利,動物園則幫助拯救瀕危的本地物種.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, Little penguin Snapper returns to the colony but will he be accepted? The vet team prepare to treat Samantran tiger Sali, and the Zoo helps to save an endangered native species at risk.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 長頸鹿嬰兒遇上族群,動物園的五個水獺兄弟正在移動,冷血動物團隊正尋找隱藏的寶藏.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Baby Giraffe meets the herd, the Zoo’s five otter brothers are on the move and the ectotherm team search for a hidden for a treasure.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這個令人驚嘆的系列以前所未有的方式揭開《貓頭鷹的秘密生活》,使用特殊的綁定攝影機在春,夏,冬季跟蹤雅息士郡鄉村荒野角落的貓頭鷹家族.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This stunning series uncovers The Secret Life Of Owls as never seen before, using a special camera rig to follow families of owls in a wild corner of rural Essex, through winter, spring and summer.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這具百萬年歷史的巨大杜爾福長毛象骨骸,急需進行世界首創的緊急修復.我們跟隨這個艱鉅的拆卸和重組脆弱化石的過程.透過電腦成像技術(CGI)和博物館知識,這部影片讓這個引人入勝卻鮮為人知的巨型生物重獲生命.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The million-year-old, giant Durfort mammoth skeleton required urgent, world-first restoration. We follow the tricky process of disassembling and reassembling the fragile fossil. Through CGI and museum knowledge, the film brings this fascinating, litt

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 討人喜歡,被視為滑稽的海鸚是冰島的國家象徵,但牠的命運令人擔憂.長達十年,海鸚伴侶停止繁殖.少數當地熱心人士現已動員起來,力挽狂瀾,拯救這種備受喜愛的海鳥.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The endearing, comical puffin is Icelands national emblem, but its fate is concerning. For a decade, couples have stopped breeding. A handful of local enthusiasts are now mobilized to save this beloved seabird.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在日本南部的九州和四國,廖崇明發現了一個充滿活力,溫馨的文化,該地的美食跟人民一樣迷人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Japans southern islands of Kyushu and Shikoku, Adam Liaw finds a vibrant, warm culture where the cuisine is as fascinating as its people.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明前往沖繩結束他的日本美食之旅,他在當地發現一道集大成的美食,並瞭解了長壽的秘訣.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam ends his taste tour through Japan with a trip to the island of Okinawa, where he discovers an eclectic cuisine and learns the secret to long life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫南非美食之旅的第一站是繁華的開普敦.他在當地到訪熱鬧的農貿市場,並在 保卡烹調開普馬來咖哩.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren’s first stop on his food trail of South Africa is the bustling city of Cape Town. Here, he visits a lively farmers market and cooks up a Cape Malay Curry in Bo Kaap.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫沿著南非海岸角繼續他的美食之旅,在抵達大森林私人自然保護區前,先到訪卡耶利沙黑人區,那裡是一些具啟發性的微型農業提案的集中地.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren continues his food trail along South Africa’s Cape Coast, stopping off at the township of Khayelitsha, home to some inspiring micro-farming initiatives, before arriving at Grootbos Private Nature Reserve.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫前往開普酒鄉,品嚐一系列當地的葡萄酒,包括南非標誌性紅酒皮諾塔吉和獨特而複雜的加烈葡萄酒華塔菲亞.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren heads to the Cape Winelands, where he tastes a variety of local wines including Pinotage, a signature South African red, and Ratafia, a unique and complex fortified wine.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫美食之旅的下一站是位於卡拉哈裡沙漠中心的提斯瓦魯豪華私人野生動物保護區.然後他遇到名廚馬努斯,烹製一些刺激的南非美食.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren’s next stop on his food trail is Tswalu Nature Reserve, in the heart of the Kalahari Desert. Warren then meets with acclaimed Chef Marnus to cook up some exciting South African delicacies.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 自90年代初,昆汀塔倫提諾一直乘坐從不減速的電影過山車,這也鞏固了他那世上最具影響力的電影製作人之一的地位.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Since the early 1990s, Quentin Tarantino has been on a cinematic rollercoaster ride, that’s never looked like slowing down, that has cemented himself as one of the worlds most influential filmmakers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 史派克李一直是位備受爭議和政治性的電影製作人,他的電影就是最好的證據.自40多年前處女作面世,他一直在美國突破界限.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Spike Lee has always been a controversial and political filmmaker whose films speak for themselves. Over 40 years since his debut in the world of film, Spike continues to push boundaries in America.

epg.programme_title_tc: 拉斐爾納達爾:紅土球王
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部紀錄片深入探討網球傳奇拉斐爾納達爾的人生,探索他從神童成長為全球巨星的歷程.透過眾多勝利和挑戰揭示拿度在球場內外所貢獻的遺產.(V374)
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This documentary delves into the life of tennis legend Rafael Nadal, exploring his journey from a young prodigy to a global icon. Through triumphs and challenges, it reveals the dedication that defines Nadal’s legacy on and off the court.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 祖拜登於2021年1月20日就任美國第46任總統,承諾在分裂的時代後團結和鎮靜,目標是恢復美國魂.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Joe Biden became the 46th US President on Jan 20, 2021, promising unity and calm after a divided era, aiming to restore the soul of America.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當川普的總統任期(2017-2021)在一片爭議和社會變革中過渡,對國家和世界產生了良久影響.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Donald Trumps presidency (2017-2021) was marked by controversy and societal shifts, leaving a lasting impact on the nation and world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 巴拉克歐巴馬是首位非裔美國總統,體現了希望,正義,寬容和平等,以他的信息和傳承啟發數百萬人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Barack Obama, the 1st African-American US President, embodied hope, justice, tolerance, and equality, inspiring millions with his message and legacy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探索比爾柯林頓複雜的影響,從阿肯色州起家到白宮的高山(經濟繁榮)與低谷(醜聞,彈劾),以及他對美國政治的影響.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore Bill Clintons complex legacy, from Arkansas roots to White House highs (economic prosperity) and lows (scandals, impeachment), and his impact on American politics.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本紀錄片審視喬治小布希的總統任期,尤其是伊拉克戰爭,其後遺症以及他的決定帶來的持久影響,包括伊斯蘭國的崛起和衝突造成的傷亡.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Documentary examines George W. Bushs presidency, focusing on the Iraq War, its aftermath, and the lasting impact of his decisions, including the rise of ISIS and the human toll of the conflict.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 朗奴雷根是一位有魅力的領袖,他用列根經濟學將美國轉營,在國內外有著不同意見,又用他富有遠見的政策和標誌性的演講永遠改變保守主義.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ronald Reagan, a charismatic leader, transformed America with Reaganomics, dividing opinion at home and abroad, and forever changing Conservatism with his visionary policies and iconic speeches.

epg.programme_title_tc: 拉斐爾納達爾:紅土球王
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部紀錄片深入探討網球傳奇拉斐爾納達爾的人生,探索他從神童成長為全球巨星的歷程.透過眾多勝利和挑戰揭示拿度在球場內外所貢獻的遺產.(V374)
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This documentary delves into the life of tennis legend Rafael Nadal, exploring his journey from a young prodigy to a global icon. Through triumphs and challenges, it reveals the dedication that defines Nadal’s legacy on and off the court.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從小鎮天才到世界第一,這部紀錄片記錄了穆雷追求卓越的堅持,與傷病的搏鬥,以及他作為網壇最具啟發性人物之一的永恆傳奇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From a small-town prodigy to World No. 1, Andy Murray: Game Set Match chronicles his relentless pursuit of greatness, his battles with injury, and his enduring legacy as one of tenniss most inspiring figures.

epg.programme_title_tc: 基利安姆巴佩:足壇新星
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 很少有球員能像基利安・姆巴佩一樣,捕捉全球球迷的想像力.在短短十多年內,他從默默無名的新秀,迅速躍升為世界上最知名,最具影響力的足球明星之一.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: There are few players who capture the imagination of fans worldwide quite like Kylian Mbappé. In just over a decade, he went from absolute obscurity to becoming one of the most famous players in the world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 細看大型軍用C-5銀河運輸機在超過半世紀的服役生涯中多次的高光時刻.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Watch the massive military transport aircraft C-5 Galaxy come up big time and again over its five decades of service

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 細看英國蘭卡斯特轟炸機如何出廠並投入行動,對德國進行毀滅性攻擊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: See how the British bomber Lancaster flew out of the factory and into action, leading devastating attacks on Germany.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《納萊迪:小象故事》講述一隻救助中心小象孤兒的旅程,被委以她生存重任的男人在奮力拯救她生命的同時,也要為保護整個物種而爭分奪秒.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Naledi follows the journey of a baby elephant orphaned in a rescue camp, as the man tasked with her survival races to protect an entire species while fighting to save her life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《下一站:中國雲南》將帶領觀眾欣賞雲南一些最美,最壯觀的風景,那是約6,000種植物,200種哺乳類動物和500種鳥類的家.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Destination China will take the audience to some of Yunnans most beautiful and stunning landscapes and homes to around 6000 species of plants, 200 mammals and 500 species of birds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《下一站:中國雲南》將帶領觀眾欣賞雲南一些最美,最壯觀的風景,那是約6,000種植物,200種哺乳類動物和500種鳥類的家.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Destination China will take the audience to some of Yunnans most beautiful and stunning landscapes and homes to around 6000 species of plants, 200 mammals and 500 species of birds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫前往開普酒鄉,品嚐一系列當地的葡萄酒,包括南非標誌性紅酒皮諾塔吉和獨特而複雜的加烈葡萄酒華塔菲亞.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren heads to the Cape Winelands, where he tastes a variety of local wines including Pinotage, a signature South African red, and Ratafia, a unique and complex fortified wine.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫美食之旅的下一站是位於卡拉哈裡沙漠中心的提斯瓦魯豪華私人野生動物保護區.然後他遇到名廚馬努斯,烹製一些刺激的南非美食.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren’s next stop on his food trail is Tswalu Nature Reserve, in the heart of the Kalahari Desert. Warren then meets with acclaimed Chef Marnus to cook up some exciting South African delicacies.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫前往沿海城市德班 - 住在標誌性的蠔盒酒店.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren heads to the coastal city of Durban - where he’s staying at the iconic Oyster Box hotel.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在德班,華倫先到訪著名的麥士生活品味餐廳,享受任性的祖魯烤肉體驗,再與當地導遊浮高碰面,參觀附近一條祖魯村莊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Durban, Warren visits the famous restaurant Max’s Lifestyle for an indulgent Shisa Nyama experience, before meeting with local guide Thoko to visit a nearby Zulu village.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫美食之行的下一站是克魯格國家公園,南非其中一個最大的野生動物保護區,他住在著名的沙比沙比旅館.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren’s next stop on his food trail is Kruger National Park, one of South Africa’s largest game reserves, where he’s staying at the renowned Sabi Sabi lodge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫在喀拉哈裡沙漠的中心發現無數的非洲動物,並學習製作傳統麵包乾來配早晨咖啡.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the heart of the Kalahari Desert, Warren spots a myriad of African animals, and learns to make traditional rusks to go with his morning coffee.

epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #5
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 基努與加德遇見享譽全球的雕塑家佩姬.布拉德利--她親手摧毀自己的藝術作品,只為創造全新的表達.透過火焰與想像,她揭示創作的真諦.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Keanu and Gard meet Paige Bradley, a world-famous sculptor who destroyed her own art to create something new. Using fire and imagination, Paige offers insight into creativity and the artistic process.

epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #6
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 基努與加德遇見馬蒂.羅德裡格,她是 OceanX 的首席科研人員.馬蒂與團隊探索未知海域,揭示大自然如何啟發我們的一切創造.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Keanu and Gard meet Mattie Rodrigue, the lead scientific researcher on OceanX. Mattie and her team explore the unknown ocean, and their work reveals how nature inspires everything we do.

epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #7
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在挪威,前衛建築師謝提爾.託森以顛覆性的思維重新定義建築--從可行走的歌劇院到沉入海中的餐廳,他的設計挑戰我們對空間的想像.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Norway, visionary architect Kjetil Thorsen is redefining the way we think about buildings and architecture with an Opera House that you can walk on and a restaurant that plunges into the sea.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 花園大道果真是南非的滄海遺珠,它是一條延伸200公裡的沿海公路,以其迷人的多樣性和無出其右的荒野而聞名.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A true hidden gem of South Africa, the Garden Route is a 200km stretch of coastal highway known for its beguiling diversity and unparalleled spirit of wilderness.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫抵達開普敦,這不會是這座城市的平凡美食探索之旅;華倫在整集節目中致力深入研究南非一種特殊的烹飪風格- 開普馬來.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren has arrived into Cape Town. This won’t be your average culinary exploration of a city; Warren has dedicated the entire episode to diving into a specific style of South African cooking known as 『Cape Malay』.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫在法蘭史霍克山谷探索博殊真度紅酒莊的無盡產物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren is in the Franschhoek Valley, exploring the endless bounty of Boschendal Wine Estate.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫繼續從心出發,前往更鮮為人知的赫爾馬努斯小鎮,在當地參觀紐頓莊臣-風景優美的紅酒農場,從而加深對紅酒的熱愛.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Continuing to listen to his heart, Warren deepens his love of wine by venturing to the lesser known town of Hermanus, where he』ll visit Newton Johnson, the 『wine farm with a view』.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫正離開開普敦前往西開普省更寧靜的沿海地區和風景如畫的帕特諾斯特小鎮.他在當地會驚嘆海邊村莊的氛圍,並沿著海灘騎電動單車.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren is heading out of Cape Town into the more quiet coastal area of the Western Cape, and the picturesque town of Paternoster. It’s here he』ll marvel at the seaside village feel and take an e-bike ride along the beach.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 作為華倫南非美食之旅的最後一章,他回歸叢林,這是所有前往彩虹國度旅行的精髓.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As the final stanza in Warren’s Food Trail of South Africa, he’s back in the bush, a quintessential part of all travel to the rainbow nation.

epg.programme_title_tc: 與馬努費德一起環遊世界 #1
epg.programme_title_en: Around The World With Manu Feildel #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 馬努費德的夢想是追隨儒勒凡爾納《80 天環遊世界》的腳步.因此,他為自己立下挑戰,要用他熱愛美食的眼界來環遊世界.他能成功嗎? 第一站-倫敦.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Manu Feildel has a dream to follow in the footsteps of Jules Vernes』 Around the World in 80 days. So Manu sets himself a challenge to circumnavigate the world, through his food loving eyes. Will he make it? First stop - London.

epg.programme_title_tc: 與馬努費德一起環遊世界 #2
epg.programme_title_en: Around The World With Manu Feildel #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 馬努在倫敦之後來到杜拜,很快就在當地累積了豐富的煮食經驗,因此他出發前往香料市場,魚市場和當地的甜品廚房.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Manu arrives in Dubai after London and is quick to dig up as much culinary experience in Dubai so he sets off to the spice souk, fish markets and a local pastry kitchen.

epg.programme_title_tc: 與馬努費德一起環遊世界 #3
epg.programme_title_en: Around The World With Manu Feildel #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 馬努生平首次到訪印度,他想發現盡量多的食物.從蒸米漿糕的製作課程,到加爾各答花卉市場的鍛鍊.他能準時,完好無缺地到達香港嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Manu is in India for the first time in his life and wants to discover as much food as he can handle. From an Idli making lesson to a workout in the flower markets of Kolkata. Will he make it to Hong Kong on time and in one piece?

epg.programme_title_tc: 基利安姆巴佩:足壇新星
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 很少有球員能像基利安・姆巴佩一樣,捕捉全球球迷的想像力.在短短十多年內,他從默默無名的新秀,迅速躍升為世界上最知名,最具影響力的足球明星之一.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: There are few players who capture the imagination of fans worldwide quite like Kylian Mbappé. In just over a decade, he went from absolute obscurity to becoming one of the most famous players in the world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部紀錄片帶領觀眾深入且全面地回顧萊昂內爾・梅西的非凡職業生涯--從阿根廷羅薩裡奧的平凡起點,到成為全球足球傳奇巨星的歷程.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This documentary offers an intimate and comprehensive journey through the extraordinary career of Lionel Messi - from his humble beginnings in Rosario, Argentina, to becoming a global football icon.

epg.programme_title_tc: 克林伊斯威特:自得其樂
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奇連伊士活是一個演員,導演和慈善家.從典型的西方偶像,到磨練他的技藝和關懷的個性.這就是他波瀾壯闊的人生故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Clint Eastwood, Actor, director and philanthropist. From being the quintessential western icon, to honing his artistic skills and caring persona. This is his magnificent story.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 細看英國蘭卡斯特轟炸機如何出廠並投入行動,對德國進行毀滅性攻擊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: See how the British bomber Lancaster flew out of the factory and into action, leading devastating attacks on Germany.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 瞭解龍捲風戰鬥轟炸機如何及為何在多年來不同場合都大派用場.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Discover how and why the fighter-bomber Panavia Tornado has been so useful in so many roles for so many years.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 長頸鹿嬰兒遇上族群,動物園的五個水獺兄弟正在移動,冷血動物團隊正尋找隱藏的寶藏.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Baby Giraffe meets the herd, the Zoo’s five otter brothers are on the move and the ectotherm team search for a hidden for a treasure.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 動物園獸醫們在今集竭力拯救地球上最瀕危的鳥類之一,過程使他們十分焦慮;而冷血動物團隊正在野生的南島執行任務.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, its an anxious time for Zoo vets as they work to save one of the most endangered birds on the planet, and the ectotherm team are on a mission in the wild South Island.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 今集,動物園在沼澤森林歡迎兩隻鱷魚,新的東南亞棲息地開張,團隊準備為南方白犀牛寶寶慶生.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, the Zoo welcomes two crocodiles to the Swamp Forest, the new South East Asia habitat opens and the team prepare for the birth of a baby southern white rhino.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奧克蘭動物園的靈長類小組準備迎接新生.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Auckland Zoo’s primate team prepare to welcome a new birth.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們跟隨奧克蘭動物園的鳥類團隊進入科羅曼德山脈的荒野,他們協助拯救本土鷸鴕的數量.這是袋獾的獵食潮,大象團隊面臨至今為止最大的挑戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: We follow Auckland Zoo’s bird team into the wilds of the Coromandel Ranges as they help to save native kiwi populations, It’s a feeding frenzy for the Tasmanian devils and the elephant team faces their biggest challenge yet.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小企鵝史拿帕在今集回到領地,但牠會被接納嗎?獸醫團隊準備治療蘇門答臘虎沙利,動物園則幫助拯救瀕危的本地物種.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, Little penguin Snapper returns to the colony but will he be accepted? The vet team prepare to treat Samantran tiger Sali, and the Zoo helps to save an endangered native species at risk.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫美食之行的下一站是克魯格國家公園,南非其中一個最大的野生動物保護區,他住在著名的沙比沙比旅館.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren’s next stop on his food trail is Kruger National Park, one of South Africa’s largest game reserves, where he’s staying at the renowned Sabi Sabi lodge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫在喀拉哈裡沙漠的中心發現無數的非洲動物,並學習製作傳統麵包乾來配早晨咖啡.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the heart of the Kalahari Desert, Warren spots a myriad of African animals, and learns to make traditional rusks to go with his morning coffee.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫來到歷史名城普利托利亞,到訪當地農夫市集,與糕點師郎高斯一起製作扭麻條(南非糯冬甩).
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren stops off at the historic city of Pretoria, where he visits the local farmers markets and cooks Koeksisters - South African sticky donuts - with Pastry Chef Nonkosi.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫在繁忙的約翰尼斯堡的第一站就是充滿活力的索維託小鎮.導遊仙迪帶他乘坐篤篤車 遊覽,並烹煮了他自己版本的一道南非素菜- 恰卡拉卡.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren is in the bustling city of Johannesburg, and his first stop is the vibrant township of Soweto. He’s taken on a tuk tuk tour by his guide Sindi, and cooks up his version of Chakalala, a South African vegetable relish.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫南非美食之旅的第一站是繁華的開普敦.他在當地到訪熱鬧的農貿市場,並在 保卡烹調開普馬來咖哩.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren’s first stop on his food trail of South Africa is the bustling city of Cape Town. Here, he visits a lively farmers market and cooks up a Cape Malay Curry in Bo Kaap.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫沿著南非海岸角繼續他的美食之旅,在抵達大森林私人自然保護區前,先到訪卡耶利沙黑人區,那裡是一些具啟發性的微型農業提案的集中地.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren continues his food trail along South Africa’s Cape Coast, stopping off at the township of Khayelitsha, home to some inspiring micro-farming initiatives, before arriving at Grootbos Private Nature Reserve.

epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #7
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在挪威,前衛建築師謝提爾.託森以顛覆性的思維重新定義建築--從可行走的歌劇院到沉入海中的餐廳,他的設計挑戰我們對空間的想像.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Norway, visionary architect Kjetil Thorsen is redefining the way we think about buildings and architecture with an Opera House that you can walk on and a restaurant that plunges into the sea.

epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #8
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ARCH 的旅程是一場關於好奇心的探索--理解靈感為何而來.在拜訪世界各地的創意先鋒後,基努與加德回到 ARCH,回顧一路上獲得的啟發與體悟.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Arch journey is about curiosity - understanding why inspiration strikes. After meeting with visionaries around the world, Keanu and Gard return to Arch to debrief the lessons learned.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從巨型媒體帝國的女繼承人到被通緝的重犯,見證1974年的派蒂赫茲綁架奇案.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From heiress of a giant media empire to wanted felon, witness the strange saga of the Patty Hearst kidnapping of 1974.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 執行長亞倫麥當勞和聯合創始人卜候活史密夫告訴我們他們如何在紐西蘭創立價值數百萬美元的非同質化代幣業務,並與國際巨星合作.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: CEO Aaron McDonald and Co-Founder Brooke Howard-Smith tell us how they created a multi-million dollar NFT business here in Aotearoa and are collaborating with international superstars.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是勵志的一集,我們花時間與團隊一起將毛利人帶到元宇宙,並了解一些當地的顛覆者,他們關注打造每個人都有歸屬感的數碼世界.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its an inspirational episode, we spend time with the team taking Māori to the metaverse and check-in on a couple of local disrupters focused on making digital worlds where everyone feels like they can belong.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 如果比特幣挖礦真能拯救世界會發生甚麼事?我們在本集會認識一家當地公司,其使命是藉此幫助解決全球暖化問題.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: What if Bitcoin mining could actually save the world? Over this episode, we meet the local company on a mission to use it to help solve global warming.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 讓我們介紹鄧嘉瑪,一位開發數碼資料主權的創造家,並瞭解非同質化代幣如何讓我們擁有自己的人工智慧.這是能震撼你的一集.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: We profile Kaye-Maree Dunn, an innovator developing digital data sovereignty and we find out how NFTs can allow us to own our own artificial intelligence. Its an episode that will blow your mind.

epg.programme_title_en: Gameplay: The Story Of The Videogame Revolution
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《電腦遊戲:電玩的故事》是一部關於電子遊戲歷史的專題紀錄片.歷時近 5 年製作,跨越了從技術起源到街機遊戲誕生的時光.從《乓》到《食鬼》,《超級瑪利歐》到《盜墓者羅拉》,《毀滅戰士》,《俠盜獵車手》等等,我們編纂有史以來發展最快的新媒體的非凡故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Gameplay is a feature on the history of videogames. From Pong to Pac Man, Super Mario to Lara Croft, Doom, Grand Theft Auto and beyond, we chronicle the remarkable story of the fastest evolving new media of all time.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 由製造花札卡牌默默發跡,到成為世上最受認可的電子遊戲公司之一,從瑪利歐和路易吉的誕生到大金剛和薩爾達⋯⋯到擊敗競爭對手並成為高品質遊戲和強大價值的平臺.這就是任天堂的故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From humble beginnings manufacturing Hanufuda cards came one of the worlds most recognised videogame companies and presenting itself as a platform for quality games and strong values. This is the story of Nintendo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 位於漢堡芬肯維德的空中巴士工廠擁有超過 16,000名工人和工程師設計,生產和交付整個歐盟中那些業內領先的飛機.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Over 16,000 workers and engineers design, produce and deliver industry leading aircraft throughout the European Union at the Airbus factory in Hamburg-Finkenwerder.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每十分鐘就有一輛新卡車從生產線出貨,配備了度身訂制的生產線,以滿足瑞典汽車集團-富豪的個別客戶需求.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Every ten minutes, a new truck rolls off the assembly line, with a tailor-made production line equipped to cater to individual customer requirements at the Swedish automotive group, Volvo.

epg.programme_title_tc: 克林伊斯威特:自得其樂
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奇連伊士活是一個演員,導演和慈善家.從典型的西方偶像,到磨練他的技藝和關懷的個性.這就是他波瀾壯闊的人生故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Clint Eastwood, Actor, director and philanthropist. From being the quintessential western icon, to honing his artistic skills and caring persona. This is his magnificent story.

epg.programme_title_tc: 瑪麗亞凱莉:毅力與魅力
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 瑪麗亞.凱莉的人生宛如童話般的灰姑娘故事.至尊歌后,聖誕女王,熱心公益的慈善家--她已售出超過 2.2 億張唱片,並推出史上最暢銷的聖誕專輯.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A Cinderella story of sorts, Mariah Carey. Songbird Supreme. Queen of Christmas. Dedicated philanthropist. Mariah has sold over 220 million records and released the best-selling Christmas album ever.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從地下俱樂部到全球巨星,《女神卡卡:為舞而生》探索這位重新定義音樂,時尚與名聲的流行偶像勢不可擋的崛起之路.在勝利與挫折交織的人生中,見證卡卡如何以舞步迎戰挑戰,並最終勝出.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From underground clubs to global superstardom, Lady Gaga: Dance or Die explores the unstoppable rise of the pop icon who redefined music, fashion, and fame. Through triumphs and tribulations, witness how Gaga danced through life’s challenges - and wo

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從越戰的叢林到中東的沙漠戰爭,見證 F-111戰鬥轟炸機的行動.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness the fighter-bomber F-111 in action, from the jungle battles of Vietnam to the desert wars of the Middle East.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 執行長亞倫麥當勞和聯合創始人卜候活史密夫告訴我們他們如何在紐西蘭創立價值數百萬美元的非同質化代幣業務,並與國際巨星合作.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: CEO Aaron McDonald and Co-Founder Brooke Howard-Smith tell us how they created a multi-million dollar NFT business here in Aotearoa and are collaborating with international superstars.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是勵志的一集,我們花時間與團隊一起將毛利人帶到元宇宙,並了解一些當地的顛覆者,他們關注打造每個人都有歸屬感的數碼世界.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its an inspirational episode, we spend time with the team taking Māori to the metaverse and check-in on a couple of local disrupters focused on making digital worlds where everyone feels like they can belong.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 如果比特幣挖礦真能拯救世界會發生甚麼事?我們在本集會認識一家當地公司,其使命是藉此幫助解決全球暖化問題.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: What if Bitcoin mining could actually save the world? Over this episode, we meet the local company on a mission to use it to help solve global warming.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 讓我們介紹鄧嘉瑪,一位開發數碼資料主權的創造家,並瞭解非同質化代幣如何讓我們擁有自己的人工智慧.這是能震撼你的一集.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: We profile Kaye-Maree Dunn, an innovator developing digital data sovereignty and we find out how NFTs can allow us to own our own artificial intelligence. Its an episode that will blow your mind.

epg.programme_title_en: Gameplay: The Story Of The Videogame Revolution
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《電腦遊戲:電玩的故事》是一部關於電子遊戲歷史的專題紀錄片.歷時近 5 年製作,跨越了從技術起源到街機遊戲誕生的時光.從《乓》到《食鬼》,《超級瑪利歐》到《盜墓者羅拉》,《毀滅戰士》,《俠盜獵車手》等等,我們編纂有史以來發展最快的新媒體的非凡故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Gameplay is a feature on the history of videogames. From Pong to Pac Man, Super Mario to Lara Croft, Doom, Grand Theft Auto and beyond, we chronicle the remarkable story of the fastest evolving new media of all time.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 洪堡洋流雖比多數洋流緩慢,卻是世界上最具活力的洋流之一,因其行經距離極長.深海海溝的湧升流將養分帶至海面,使浮遊植物大量繁盛,奠定複雜海洋食物鏈的基礎.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這股洋流伴隨著智利獨特的藍鯨族群,也是其他極度稀有海洋哺乳動物的最後避風港.從冰冷深海到高崖強風,洋流塑造出奇特棲地,也是一部關於生存的自然研究.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The current is followed by a unique population of Chilean blue whales and is the last refuge for other extremely rare marine mammals. From the chill of its deepest depths to the wind on its highest cliffs the current creates unusual habitats and is a

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明在蓬勃發展傳統文化的京都遇到了一位茗茶大師,一位藝伎和一位將義大利飯變成壽司的米芝蓮大廚.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam meets a tea master, a Maiko, and a Michelin chef who turns risotto into sushi in the thriving traditional culture of Kyoto.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明探索日本充滿活力的金融中心- 大阪,發現世上最好的快餐,一位相撲力士出身的大廚,以及味道令人死而無憾的蕎麥麵.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw explores Japans high-energy financial centre, Osaka, and finds the worlds best fast food, a sumo wrestler turned chef, and soba noodles to die for.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在日本南部的九州和四國,廖崇明發現了一個充滿活力,溫馨的文化,該地的美食跟人民一樣迷人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Japans southern islands of Kyushu and Shikoku, Adam Liaw finds a vibrant, warm culture where the cuisine is as fascinating as its people.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明前往沖繩結束他的日本美食之旅,他在當地發現一道集大成的美食,並瞭解了長壽的秘訣.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam ends his taste tour through Japan with a trip to the island of Okinawa, where he discovers an eclectic cuisine and learns the secret to long life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫南非美食之旅的第一站是繁華的開普敦.他在當地到訪熱鬧的農貿市場,並在 保卡烹調開普馬來咖哩.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren’s first stop on his food trail of South Africa is the bustling city of Cape Town. Here, he visits a lively farmers market and cooks up a Cape Malay Curry in Bo Kaap.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫沿著南非海岸角繼續他的美食之旅,在抵達大森林私人自然保護區前,先到訪卡耶利沙黑人區,那裡是一些具啟發性的微型農業提案的集中地.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren continues his food trail along South Africa’s Cape Coast, stopping off at the township of Khayelitsha, home to some inspiring micro-farming initiatives, before arriving at Grootbos Private Nature Reserve.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫前往開普酒鄉,品嚐一系列當地的葡萄酒,包括南非標誌性紅酒皮諾塔吉和獨特而複雜的加烈葡萄酒華塔菲亞.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren heads to the Cape Winelands, where he tastes a variety of local wines including Pinotage, a signature South African red, and Ratafia, a unique and complex fortified wine.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫美食之旅的下一站是位於卡拉哈裡沙漠中心的提斯瓦魯豪華私人野生動物保護區.然後他遇到名廚馬努斯,烹製一些刺激的南非美食.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren’s next stop on his food trail is Tswalu Nature Reserve, in the heart of the Kalahari Desert. Warren then meets with acclaimed Chef Marnus to cook up some exciting South African delicacies.

epg.programme_title_tc: 與馬努費德一起環遊世界 #1
epg.programme_title_en: Around The World With Manu Feildel #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 馬努費德的夢想是追隨儒勒凡爾納《80 天環遊世界》的腳步.因此,他為自己立下挑戰,要用他熱愛美食的眼界來環遊世界.他能成功嗎? 第一站-倫敦.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Manu Feildel has a dream to follow in the footsteps of Jules Vernes』 Around the World in 80 days. So Manu sets himself a challenge to circumnavigate the world, through his food loving eyes. Will he make it? First stop - London.

epg.programme_title_tc: 與馬努費德一起環遊世界 #2
epg.programme_title_en: Around The World With Manu Feildel #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 馬努在倫敦之後來到杜拜,很快就在當地累積了豐富的煮食經驗,因此他出發前往香料市場,魚市場和當地的甜品廚房.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Manu arrives in Dubai after London and is quick to dig up as much culinary experience in Dubai so he sets off to the spice souk, fish markets and a local pastry kitchen.

epg.programme_title_tc: 與馬努費德一起環遊世界 #3
epg.programme_title_en: Around The World With Manu Feildel #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 馬努生平首次到訪印度,他想發現盡量多的食物.從蒸米漿糕的製作課程,到加爾各答花卉市場的鍛鍊.他能準時,完好無缺地到達香港嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Manu is in India for the first time in his life and wants to discover as much food as he can handle. From an Idli making lesson to a workout in the flower markets of Kolkata. Will he make it to Hong Kong on time and in one piece?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫前往沿海城市德班 - 住在標誌性的蠔盒酒店.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren heads to the coastal city of Durban - where he’s staying at the iconic Oyster Box hotel.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在德班,華倫先到訪著名的麥士生活品味餐廳,享受任性的祖魯烤肉體驗,再與當地導遊浮高碰面,參觀附近一條祖魯村莊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Durban, Warren visits the famous restaurant Max’s Lifestyle for an indulgent Shisa Nyama experience, before meeting with local guide Thoko to visit a nearby Zulu village.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫美食之行的下一站是克魯格國家公園,南非其中一個最大的野生動物保護區,他住在著名的沙比沙比旅館.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren’s next stop on his food trail is Kruger National Park, one of South Africa’s largest game reserves, where he’s staying at the renowned Sabi Sabi lodge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫在喀拉哈裡沙漠的中心發現無數的非洲動物,並學習製作傳統麵包乾來配早晨咖啡.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the heart of the Kalahari Desert, Warren spots a myriad of African animals, and learns to make traditional rusks to go with his morning coffee.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫來到歷史名城普利托利亞,到訪當地農夫市集,與糕點師郎高斯一起製作扭麻條(南非糯冬甩).
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren stops off at the historic city of Pretoria, where he visits the local farmers markets and cooks Koeksisters - South African sticky donuts - with Pastry Chef Nonkosi.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫在繁忙的約翰尼斯堡的第一站就是充滿活力的索維託小鎮.導遊仙迪帶他乘坐篤篤車 遊覽,並烹煮了他自己版本的一道南非素菜- 恰卡拉卡.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren is in the bustling city of Johannesburg, and his first stop is the vibrant township of Soweto. He’s taken on a tuk tuk tour by his guide Sindi, and cooks up his version of Chakalala, a South African vegetable relish.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫南非美食之旅的第一站是繁華的開普敦.他在當地到訪熱鬧的農貿市場,並在 保卡烹調開普馬來咖哩.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Naledi follows the journey of a baby elephant orphaned in a rescue camp, as the man tasked with her survival races to protect an entire species while fighting to save her life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《下一站:中國雲南》將帶領觀眾欣賞雲南一些最美,最壯觀的風景,那是約6,000種植物,200種哺乳類動物和500種鳥類的家.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Destination China will take the audience to some of Yunnans most beautiful and stunning landscapes and homes to around 6000 species of plants, 200 mammals and 500 species of birds.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: This stunning series uncovers The Secret Life Of Owls as never seen before, using a special camera rig to follow families of owls in a wild corner of rural Essex, through winter, spring and summer.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The endearing, comical puffin is Icelands national emblem, but its fate is concerning. For a decade, couples have stopped breeding. A handful of local enthusiasts are now mobilized to save this beloved seabird.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The endearing, comical puffin is Icelands national emblem, but its fate is concerning. For a decade, couples have stopped breeding. A handful of local enthusiasts are now mobilized to save this beloved seabird.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 細看英國蘭卡斯特轟炸機如何出廠並投入行動,對德國進行毀滅性攻擊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: See how the British bomber Lancaster flew out of the factory and into action, leading devastating attacks on Germany.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 瞭解龍捲風戰鬥轟炸機如何及為何在多年來不同場合都大派用場.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness the fighter-bomber F-111 in action, from the jungle battles of Vietnam to the desert wars of the Middle East.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: See how the P-47 Thunderbolt dominated the skies while dealing destruction on the ground in both Germany and the Pacific.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: From night stalker missions to rescue operations, see how the Little Bird helicopter earned its place among the big boys.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Baby Giraffe meets the herd, the Zoo’s five otter brothers are on the move and the ectotherm team search for a hidden for a treasure.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 動物園獸醫們在今集竭力拯救地球上最瀕危的鳥類之一,過程使他們十分焦慮;而冷血動物團隊正在野生的南島執行任務.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, its an anxious time for Zoo vets as they work to save one of the most endangered birds on the planet, and the ectotherm team are on a mission in the wild South Island.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 今集,動物園在沼澤森林歡迎兩隻鱷魚,新的東南亞棲息地開張,團隊準備為南方白犀牛寶寶慶生.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, the Zoo welcomes two crocodiles to the Swamp Forest, the new South East Asia habitat opens and the team prepare for the birth of a baby southern white rhino.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奧克蘭動物園的靈長類小組準備迎接新生.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Auckland Zoo’s primate team prepare to welcome a new birth.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們跟隨奧克蘭動物園的鳥類團隊進入科羅曼德山脈的荒野,他們協助拯救本土鷸鴕的數量.這是袋獾的獵食潮,大象團隊面臨至今為止最大的挑戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: We follow Auckland Zoo’s bird team into the wilds of the Coromandel Ranges as they help to save native kiwi populations, It’s a feeding frenzy for the Tasmanian devils and the elephant team faces their biggest challenge yet.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小企鵝史拿帕在今集回到領地,但牠會被接納嗎?獸醫團隊準備治療蘇門答臘虎沙利,動物園則幫助拯救瀕危的本地物種.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, Little penguin Snapper returns to the colony but will he be accepted? The vet team prepare to treat Samantran tiger Sali, and the Zoo helps to save an endangered native species at risk.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 洪堡洋流雖比多數洋流緩慢,卻是世界上最具活力的洋流之一,因其行經距離極長.深海海溝的湧升流將養分帶至海面,使浮遊植物大量繁盛,奠定複雜海洋食物鏈的基礎.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: From humble beginnings manufacturing Hanufuda cards came one of the worlds most recognised videogame companies and presenting itself as a platform for quality games and strong values. This is the story of Nintendo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 位於漢堡芬肯維德的空中巴士工廠擁有超過 16,000名工人和工程師設計,生產和交付整個歐盟中那些業內領先的飛機.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Over 16,000 workers and engineers design, produce and deliver industry leading aircraft throughout the European Union at the Airbus factory in Hamburg-Finkenwerder.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每十分鐘就有一輛新卡車從生產線出貨,配備了度身訂制的生產線,以滿足瑞典汽車集團-富豪的個別客戶需求.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Every ten minutes, a new truck rolls off the assembly line, with a tailor-made production line equipped to cater to individual customer requirements at the Swedish automotive group, Volvo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 由製造花札卡牌默默發跡,到成為世上最受認可的電子遊戲公司之一,從瑪利歐和路易吉的誕生到大金剛和薩爾達⋯⋯到擊敗競爭對手並成為高品質遊戲和強大價值的平臺.這就是任天堂的故事.

epg.programme_title_en: Canada: A Year In The Wild #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 隨著日照越短,天氣越寒冷,加拿大的野生動物正與時間競賽,任何無法好好利用秋天作準備的動物都將滅亡.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: With days growing shorter and colder, Canadian wildlife is in a race against time, and any animal that fails to make the most of what autumn has to offer will perish.

epg.programme_title_en: Canada: A Year In The Wild #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 加拿大的冬天既殘酷又美麗;動物們在冰天雪地裡掙扎求存;不過,雖然有些動物會靜候蓄力,另一些需要撫養孩子的動物則需要迅速適應環境.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Winter in Canada is both cruel and beautiful; in the grip of snow and ice, and animals are struggling; however, while some animals hunker down, others have babies to raise who need to adjust to their environment swiftly.

epg.programme_title_tc: 與馬努費德一起環遊世界 #1
epg.programme_title_en: Around The World With Manu Feildel #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 馬努費德的夢想是追隨儒勒凡爾納《80 天環遊世界》的腳步.因此,他為自己立下挑戰,要用他熱愛美食的眼界來環遊世界.他能成功嗎? 第一站-倫敦.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Manu Feildel has a dream to follow in the footsteps of Jules Vernes』 Around the World in 80 days. So Manu sets himself a challenge to circumnavigate the world, through his food loving eyes. Will he make it? First stop - London.

epg.programme_title_tc: 與馬努費德一起環遊世界 #2
epg.programme_title_en: Around The World With Manu Feildel #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 馬努在倫敦之後來到杜拜,很快就在當地累積了豐富的煮食經驗,因此他出發前往香料市場,魚市場和當地的甜品廚房.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Manu arrives in Dubai after London and is quick to dig up as much culinary experience in Dubai so he sets off to the spice souk, fish markets and a local pastry kitchen.

epg.programme_title_tc: 與馬努費德一起環遊世界 #3
epg.programme_title_en: Around The World With Manu Feildel #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 馬努生平首次到訪印度,他想發現盡量多的食物.從蒸米漿糕的製作課程,到加爾各答花卉市場的鍛鍊.他能準時,完好無缺地到達香港嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Manu is in India for the first time in his life and wants to discover as much food as he can handle. From an Idli making lesson to a workout in the flower markets of Kolkata. Will he make it to Hong Kong on time and in one piece?

epg.programme_title_tc: 拉斐爾納達爾:紅土球王
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部紀錄片深入探討網球傳奇拉斐爾納達爾的人生,探索他從神童成長為全球巨星的歷程.透過眾多勝利和挑戰揭示拿度在球場內外所貢獻的遺產.(V374)
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This documentary delves into the life of tennis legend Rafael Nadal, exploring his journey from a young prodigy to a global icon. Through triumphs and challenges, it reveals the dedication that defines Nadal’s legacy on and off the court.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從小鎮天才到世界第一,這部紀錄片記錄了穆雷追求卓越的堅持,與傷病的搏鬥,以及他作為網壇最具啟發性人物之一的永恆傳奇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From a small-town prodigy to World No. 1, Andy Murray: Game Set Match chronicles his relentless pursuit of greatness, his battles with injury, and his enduring legacy as one of tenniss most inspiring figures.

epg.programme_title_tc: 基利安姆巴佩:足壇新星
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 很少有球員能像基利安・姆巴佩一樣,捕捉全球球迷的想像力.在短短十多年內,他從默默無名的新秀,迅速躍升為世界上最知名,最具影響力的足球明星之一.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: There are few players who capture the imagination of fans worldwide quite like Kylian Mbappé. In just over a decade, he went from absolute obscurity to becoming one of the most famous players in the world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《納萊迪:小象故事》講述一隻救助中心小象孤兒的旅程,被委以她生存重任的男人在奮力拯救她生命的同時,也要為保護整個物種而爭分奪秒.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Naledi follows the journey of a baby elephant orphaned in a rescue camp, as the man tasked with her survival races to protect an entire species while fighting to save her life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《下一站:中國雲南》將帶領觀眾欣賞雲南一些最美,最壯觀的風景,那是約6,000種植物,200種哺乳類動物和500種鳥類的家.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Destination China will take the audience to some of Yunnans most beautiful and stunning landscapes and homes to around 6000 species of plants, 200 mammals and 500 species of birds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《下一站:中國雲南》將帶領觀眾欣賞雲南一些最美,最壯觀的風景,那是約6,000種植物,200種哺乳類動物和500種鳥類的家.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Destination China will take the audience to some of Yunnans most beautiful and stunning landscapes and homes to around 6000 species of plants, 200 mammals and 500 species of birds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 認識新任野外戰士義工,他們將加入韋札的動物大家庭.變髒是工作的一部分.當然,隨時會有衝擊性的驚喜.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet the new wild warrior volunteers, as they are introduced to Imire’s extended animal family. Getting dirty is part of the job. And of course, there are always striking surprises at any moment.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們在本集目睹一場拯救一隻受驚黑高角羚的絕望任務.這些反偷獵的大象智慧震驚所有人.而且,總能忙裡偷閒.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode, we witness a desperate mission to save a spooked impala. The intelligence of these anti poaching elephants astounds everyone. And, there is always time for fun tasks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 義工們在本集近距離接觸標誌性的動物.深入瞭解韋札的反偷獵成就.還有,努力無堅不摧.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episoden the volunteers experience close up encounters with iconic creatures. Immersion into Imire’s anti-poaching efforts. And, nothing stands in the way of hard work.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 義工們探索社區在保育中扮演的角色,包括令人興奮的蜂蜜收成,新團員的加入,以及其中一人餵哺黑犀牛的夢想成真.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Volunteers explore the community’s role in conservation, with thrilling honey harvesting, a new addition to the team, and a dream come true as one feeds a black rhino.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在引人入勝的本集,雷利分享他放生犀牛的夢想.茱迪心愛的麂羚是時候回歸大自然.例行的東非條紋羚捕捉行動發生意想不到的轉折.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this engaging episode, Reilly shares his rhino release dream. It’s time for Judy’s beloved duiker to return to the wild. And, a routine nyala capture takes an unexpected turn.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在本集一個疣豬回收行動出了差錯.來認識韋札保育區的母系社會,一頭奇特大象的獨家故事.是時候告別韋札的家人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode, a warthog retrieval mission goes awry. Meet the matriarch of Imire, a wonderful elephant that has a unique story. It’s time to say farewell to the Imire family.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從巨型媒體帝國的女繼承人到被通緝的重犯,見證1974年的派蒂赫茲綁架奇案.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From heiress of a giant media empire to wanted felon, witness the strange saga of the Patty Hearst kidnapping of 1974.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 以當時報導山姆之子的方式呈現事件,讓你沉浸在這謀殺案的戲劇中.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Immerse yourself in the drama of the Son of Sam murders, presented the way the events were covered at the time.

epg.programme_title_tc: 前進宇宙:太空,競賽,火星與更遠之處
epg.programme_title_en: Into the Cosmos: The Space Race, Mars And Beyond
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 看看太空旅行的發展,以及人類某天踏足火星的潛力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A look at the development of space travel and the potential for humans to one day walk on the surface of Mars.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從越戰的叢林到中東的沙漠戰爭,見證 F-111戰鬥轟炸機的行動.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness the fighter-bomber F-111 in action, from the jungle battles of Vietnam to the desert wars of the Middle East.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 瞭解P-47雷霆式戰鬥機如何在德國和太平洋地區制霸空戰,還能同時對地面造成破壞.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: See how the P-47 Thunderbolt dominated the skies while dealing destruction on the ground in both Germany and the Pacific.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《納萊迪:小象故事》講述一隻救助中心小象孤兒的旅程,被委以她生存重任的男人在奮力拯救她生命的同時,也要為保護整個物種而爭分奪秒.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Naledi follows the journey of a baby elephant orphaned in a rescue camp, as the man tasked with her survival races to protect an entire species while fighting to save her life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《下一站:中國雲南》將帶領觀眾欣賞雲南一些最美,最壯觀的風景,那是約6,000種植物,200種哺乳類動物和500種鳥類的家.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Destination China will take the audience to some of Yunnans most beautiful and stunning landscapes and homes to around 6000 species of plants, 200 mammals and 500 species of birds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《下一站:中國雲南》將帶領觀眾欣賞雲南一些最美,最壯觀的風景,那是約6,000種植物,200種哺乳類動物和500種鳥類的家.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Destination China will take the audience to some of Yunnans most beautiful and stunning landscapes and homes to around 6000 species of plants, 200 mammals and 500 species of birds.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet the new wild warrior volunteers, as they are introduced to Imire’s extended animal family. Getting dirty is part of the job. And of course, there are always striking surprises at any moment.
